Kindred's third Attack against the target within {{ totalduration }} seconds of each other directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, dealing an additional {{ basebitedamage }} plus {{ percentbitedamage }} missing Health physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Lamb's Respite
spells.description: Lamb grants all living things inside a zone a respite from death. Until the effect ends, nothing can die. At the end, units are healed.
spells.descriptionPt: A Ovelha concede refúgio contra a morte para todos os seres vivos em uma área. Até que seu efeito acabe, nada pode morrer. No fim de sua duração, as unidades são curadas.
spells.tooltip: Kindred blesses the ground for {{ buffduration }} seconds, allowing no unit, ally, enemy, or neutral to die while inside. Upon reaching 10% Health, units can't be damaged or healed while still inside the zone. When the blessing ends, all units inside heal for {{ healflat }} Health .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard
passive.description: Kled rides his trusty steed, Skaarl, who takes damage for him. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts. While dismounted, Kled's abilities change and he deals less damage to champions. Kled can restore Skaarl's courage by fighting enemies. At maximum courage, Kled remounts with a portion of Skaarl's health.
passive.descriptionPt: Kled fica em sua possante montaria, Skaarl, que toma dano por ele. Quando a Vida dela acaba, Kled desmonta. Enquanto desmontado, as habilidades de Kled mudam e ele causa menos dano a Campeões. Kled pode restaurar a coragem de Skaarl ao enfrentar inimigos. Quando a coragem chega ao máximo, Kled volta a montar em Skaarl com uma parte de sua Vida.

spells.name: Bear Trap on a Rope
spells.description: Kled throws a bear trap that damages and hooks an enemy champion. If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled. When dismounted, this ability is replaced by Pocket Pistol, a ranged gun blast that knocks back Kled and restores courage.
spells.descriptionPt: Kled arremessa uma armadilha de urso que causa dano e se prende a um Campeão inimigo. Caso fique preso por um curto período, o alvo recebe Dano Físico adicional e é puxado em direção a Kled. Quando desmontado, esta habilidade é substituída por Pistola de Bolso, um disparo a distância que empurra Kled para trás e restaura coragem.
spells.tooltip: Mounted: Kled throws a bear trap that deals {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and hooks onto the first enemy champion or large jungle monster hit. If Kled stays near a hooked enemy for {{ tetherpoptime }} seconds, he yanks out the trap, dealing {{ totalyankdamage }} physical damage , Pulling them, and Slowing by {{ slowamount*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Violent Tendencies
spells.description: Kled gains massive attack speed for four attacks. The fourth attack deals more damage.
spells.descriptionPt: Kled recebe muita Velocidade de Ataque por quatro ataques. O quarto ataque causa mais dano.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Kled's next Attack grants {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed for four Attacks or {{ activeduration }} seconds. The fourth hit deals an additional {{ baseflatdamage }} plus {{ percentdamage }} max Health physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Jousting
spells.description: Kled dashes, dealing physical damage and gaining a short burst of speed. Kled can cast this ability again to dash back through his initial target, dealing the same damage.
spells.descriptionPt: Kled avança, causando Dano Físico e recebendo um breve surto de velocidade. Ele pode conjurar esta habilidade novamente para recuar através do alvo inicial, causando a mesma quantidade de dano.
spells.tooltip: Kled dashes, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to enemies he passes through, pulling minions and small monsters towards him. If this Ability hits an enemy champion or large jungle monster, Kled gains {{ movespeed*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ movespeedduration }} second(s) and can Recast within {{ recastwindow }} seconds to dash back through the same target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
spells.description: Kled and Skaarl charge to a location, leaving a speed-granting trail behind them and gaining a shield. Skaarl locks onto and rams the first enemy champion encountered.
spells.descriptionPt: Kled e Skaarl avançam em direção a um local, deixando um rastro que concede velocidade e criando um escudo. Skaarl marca e vai de encontro ao primeiro Campeão inimigo encontrado.
spells.tooltip: Kled charges toward an area, leaving a trail that grants allies increasing Move Speed . While charging and for 2 seconds after Kled gains up to {{ maximumshield }} Shield . Skaarl rams the first enemy champion encountered, dealing {{ minimumdamagetooltip }} to {{ maximumchargedamage }} max Health magic damage (based on distance travelled) and briefly Knocking Back .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Icathian Surprise
passive.description: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.
passive.descriptionPt: Ao morrer, Kog'Maw explode depois de 4s, causando Dano Verdadeiro a inimigos próximos.

spells.name: Caustic Spittle
spells.description: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed.
spells.descriptionPt: Kog'Maw dispara um projétil corrosivo que causa Dano Mágico, corroendo a Armadura e Resistência Mágica do alvo por um curto período de tempo. Kog'Maw também recebe Velocidade de Ataque adicional.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Kog'Maw gains {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed . Active: Kog'Maw vomits a corrosive projectile that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first enemy hit and shreds {{ shredamount }}% Armor and Magic Resist for {{ shredduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
spells.description: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit .
spells.descriptionPt: Os ataques de Kog'Maw recebem alcance e causam um percentual da Vida máxima do alvo como Dano Mágico %i:OnHit% ao contato .
spells.tooltip: Kog'Maw gains {{ range }} Attack Range and his Attacks deal an additional {{ totalhealthdamage }} max Health magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Void Ooze
spells.description: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.
spells.descriptionPt: Kog'Maw lança uma gosma que causa dano em todos os inimigos pelos quais ela passa, deixando um rastro que reduz a velocidade de inimigos que ficarem sobre ela.
spells.tooltip: Kog'Maw spits bile, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and leaving a trail of ooze for {{ trailduration }} seconds. Enemies in the ooze are Slowed by {{ slowamount }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Living Artillery
spells.description: Kog'Maw fires an artillery shell at a great distance dealing magic damage (increased significantly on low health enemies) and revealing non-stealthed targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana.
spells.descriptionPt: Kog'Maw dispara uma cápsula de artilharia a uma grande distância, causando Dano Mágico (aumentado drasticamente em inimigos com pouca Vida) e revelando alvos não invisíveis. Além disso, mais de uma Artilharia Viva em um curto período de tempo faz com que custem Mana adicional.
spells.tooltip: Kog'Maw shoots acid at an area, dealing {{ basedamagecalc }} plus {{ tooltipmissinghealthdamageamp }}% per 1% missing Health magic damage and revealing enemies hit for 2 seconds. Enemies below 40% Health instead take {{ maxdamagecalc }} magic damage . Subsequent shots within {{ manacostduration }} seconds cost an additional {{ basecost }} Mana (max: {{ manacostcap }} Mana ).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Mirror Image
passive.description: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.
passive.descriptionPt: Quando a Vida de LeBlanc está abaixo de 40%, ela fica invisível por 1s e cria uma Imagem-Espelho que não causa dano e dura até 8s.

spells.name: Sigil of Malice
spells.description: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown.
spells.descriptionPt: LeBlanc projeta um Sigilo, causando dano e marcando o alvo por 3,5s. Causar dano ao alvo marcado com qualquer Habilidade detona o Sigilo, causando dano adicional. Se qualquer parte dessa combinação abater o alvo, LeBlanc restitui o custo de Mana e parte do Tempo de Recarga restante desta Habilidade.
spells.tooltip: LeBlanc projects a sigil to an enemy, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and marking them for {{ markduration }} seconds. Damaging the marked enemy with an Ability detonates the sigil, dealing {{ markdamage }} magic damage . If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds {{ manarefund*100 }}% of the Mana cost and {{ cooldownrefund*100 }}% of this spell's remaining Cooldown. The initial sigil deals an additional {{ bonusminiondamage }} damage to minions. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Distortion
spells.description: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.
spells.descriptionPt: LeBlanc avança até um local, causando dano aos inimigos próximos de seu destino. Pelos próximos 4s, ativar Distorção novamente faz com que LeBlanc retorne até sua posição inicial.
spells.tooltip: LeBlanc dashes then deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to nearby enemies. For {{ snapbacktimeallowed }} seconds after dashing, LeBlanc can Recast . Recast: LeBlanc returns to her starting location.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ethereal Chains
spells.description: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.
spells.descriptionPt: LeBlanc lança uma corrente que prende a primeira unidade atingida. Se o alvo permanecer preso por 1,5s, ele é enraizado e sofre dano adicional.
spells.tooltip: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit, dealing {{ initialdamage }} magic damage and granting True Sight . If they remain shackled for {{ tetherduration }} seconds, LeBlanc Roots them for {{ rootduration }} seconds and deals an additional {{ delayeddamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Mimic
spells.description: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.
spells.descriptionPt: Leblanc conjura uma versão copiada de uma de suas habilidades.
spells.tooltip: LeBlanc mimics her most recent Ability, using it again. The mimicked Ability deals increased damage. Mimicked Sigil of Malice deals {{ rq1damage }} magic damage when applied, and {{ rq2damage }} magic damage when consumed. Mimicked Distortion deals {{ rwdamage }} magic damage . Mimicked Ethereal Chains deals {{ re1damage }} magic damage when shackled and {{ re2damage }} magic damage when Rooting .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Flurry
passive.description: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.
passive.descriptionPt: Após Lee Sin usar uma habilidade, seus próximos 2 ataques básicos recebem Velocidade de Ataque e recuperam Energia.

spells.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
spells.description: Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds. Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.
spells.descriptionPt: Onda Sônica: Lee Sin projeta uma onda sonora para localizar seus inimigos, causando Dano Físico ao primeiro que encontrar. Se Onda Sônica atingir um inimigo, Lee Sin pode conjurar Ataque Ressonante nos próximos 3 segundos. Ataque Ressonante: Lee Sin avança no inimigo atingido por Onda Sônica, causando Dano Físico baseado na Vida perdida do alvo.
spells.tooltip: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound, dealing {{ initialdamage }} physical damage to the first enemy hit, granting True Sight of them, and allows Lee Sin to Recast for the next {{ reactivatetime }} seconds. Recast: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by the sound wave, dealing between {{ recastdamage }} to {{ empowereddamage }} physical damage scaling with the target's missing Health. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
spells.description: Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will. Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.
spells.descriptionPt: Proteger: Lee Sin avança até um aliado-alvo, protegendo-se do dano com um Escudo. Se o aliado for um Campeão, ele também é protegido pelo Escudo. Após usar Proteger, Lee Sin pode conjurar Vontade de Ferro. Vontade de Ferro: o treinamento intenso de Lee Sin permite que ele fique mais resistente em combate. Lee Sin recebe Vampirismo Universal.
spells.tooltip: Lee Sin dashes to an ally or ward. If the target is a champion, Lee Sin grants them and himself {{ shieldamount }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. Lee Sin may Recast for the next {{ w1reactivatetime }} seconds. Recast: Lee Sin gains {{ lifestealandspellvamp }}% Omnivamp for {{ lifestealandspellvamptime }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tempest / Cripple
spells.description: Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple. Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.
spells.descriptionPt: Tempestade: Lee Sin golpeia o chão, enviando uma onda de choque que causa Dano Mágico e revela unidades inimigas atingidas. Se Tempestade atingir um inimigo, Lee Sin pode conjurar Mutilar. Mutilar: Lee Sin mutila inimigos próximos que tenham sido atingidos por Tempestade, reduzindo a Velocidade de Movimento deles. A Velocidade de Movimento é recuperada gradualmente ao longo da duração.
spells.tooltip: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals {{ initialdamage }} magic damage and reveals them for {{ slowduration }} seconds. If this hits an enemy, Lee Sin can Recast for the next {{ reactivatetime }} seconds. Recast: Lee Sin Slows nearby enemies struck by the shockwave by {{ slowamount }}% decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Dragon's Rage
spells.description: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.
spells.descriptionPt: Lee Sin executa um poderoso chute giratório, arremessando seu alvo para trás e causando Dano Físico ao alvo e a qualquer inimigo com quem ele colidir. Esses inimigos são lançados ao ar durante um curto período. Essa técnica foi ensinada a ele por Jesse Perring, mas Lee Sin não chuta os jogadores para fora do mapa.
spells.tooltip: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick Knocking Back an enemy champion and dealing {{ damage }} physical damage . Enemies the target collides with are briefly Knocked Up and take {{ damage }} plus {{ percenthpcarrythrough }}% of the kicked enemy's bonus Health as physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Sunlight
passive.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.
passive.descriptionPt: Habilidades que causam dano atingem os inimigos com Luz do Sol por 1,5s. Quando Campeões aliados causam dano a esses alvos, a Luz do Sol é consumida para causar Dano Mágico adicional.

spells.name: Shield of Daybreak
spells.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.
spells.descriptionPt: Leona usa seu escudo para fazer seu próximo ataque básico, causando Dano Mágico adicional e atordoando o alvo.
spells.tooltip: Leona's next Attack Stuns for {{ stunduration }} seconds and deals an additional {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Eclipse
spells.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.
spells.descriptionPt: Leona ergue seu escudo para receber redução de dano, Armadura e Resistência Mágica. Quando a duração chegar ao fim, caso haja inimigos próximos, ela causará Dano Mágico a eles e prolongará a duração do efeito.
spells.tooltip: Leona raises her shield, reducing incoming damage by {{ flatdamagereduction }} and gaining {{ bonusarmortooltip }} Armor and {{ bonusmrtooltip }} Magic Resist for {{ armormrduration }} seconds. Afterwards, her shield detonates, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits at least one, she retains the Armor and Magic Resist bonuses for an additional {{ armormrduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Zenith Blade
spells.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.
spells.descriptionPt: Leona projeta uma imagem solar da sua espada, causando Dano Mágico a todos os inimigos em uma fila. Quando a imagem some, o último campeão inimigo a ser acertado fica imobilizado por um curto periodo e Leona o ataca.
spells.tooltip: Leona thrusts with a sword of light, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage . The last champion struck will be Rooted for {{ rootduration }} seconds and Leona will dash to them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Solar Flare
spells.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.
spells.descriptionPt: Leona invoca um raio de energia solar do céu, causando dano aos inimigos em uma área. Inimigos no centro da área são atordoados, enquanto inimigos próximos à extremidade sofrem redução de velocidade.
spells.tooltip: Leona calls down a radiant beam of solar energy dealing {{ explosioncalculateddamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ ccduration }} seconds. Enemies in the center of the flare are Stunned instead of Slowed .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Dream-Laden Bough
passive.description: Hitting a champion or monster with a skill will deal additional max Health damage over time.
passive.descriptionPt: Atingir um Campeão ou monstro com uma habilidade causa dano adicional com base na Vida máxima do alvo ao longo do tempo.

spells.name: Blooming Blows
spells.description: Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells. She can activate this to deal magic damage to nearby enemies, dealing extra true damage on the edge.
spells.descriptionPt: Lillia ganha acúmulos de Velocidade de Movimento passivamente ao atingir inimigos com habilidades. Ela pode ativar esta habilidade para causar Dano Mágico aos inimigos próximos e Dano Verdadeiro adicional na porção externa do círculo.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Lillia's Ability hits grant {{ prancespeed }} Move Speed for {{ pranceduration }} seconds, stacking up to {{ prancemaxstacks }} times. Active: Lillia whirls her censer, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage , plus an additional {{ bonustruedamage }} true damage at the outer edge.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Watch Out! Eep!
spells.description: Lillia deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center.
spells.descriptionPt: Lillia causa dano em uma área próxima, com dano amplificado no centro.
spells.tooltip: Lillia winds up a huge strike, dealing {{ flatdamage }} magic damage . Enemies in the center take {{ flatdamagesweetspot }} damage instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Swirlseed
spells.description: Lillia hurls a seed that damages and slows those it lands on. If it doesn't hit anything, it will continue rolling until it hits a wall or target.
spells.descriptionPt: Lillia lança uma semente que causa dano e reduz a velocidade dos inimigos atingidos. Caso não atinja nada, Semente Espiral continuará avançando até colidir com uma parede ou alvo.
spells.tooltip: Lillia lobs a swirlseed overhead, dealing {{ impactdamagetotal }} magic damage where it lands and revealing and Slowing them by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. If no enemies are hit, the seed rolls until it hits an enemy or collides with terrain.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Lilting Lullaby
spells.description: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.
spells.descriptionPt: Todos os inimigos com Pó dos Sonhos são afetados por Sonolência e adormecem em seguida. Esses inimigos sofrem dano adicional se forem acordados de forma abrupta por dano.
spells.tooltip: Lillia causes all enemy champions with Dream Dust to become Drowsy for {{ drowsyduration }} seconds. Afterward, they fall Asleep for {{ sleepduration }} seconds. When awakened by damage, they take an additional {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Iceborn Subjugation
passive.description: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a Frozen Thrall. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies and then, after a delay, shatter from the intense cold, dealing magic damage to nearby targets.
passive.descriptionPt: Quando um Campeão inimigo morre próximo a Lissandra, ele vira um Servo Congelado. Servos Congelados reduzem a velocidade de inimigos próximos e, depois de um intervalo, estilhaçam devido ao frio intenso, causando Dano Mágico a alvos próximos.

spells.name: Ice Shard
spells.description: Throws a spear of ice that shatters when it hits an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing Move Speed. Shards pass through the target, dealing the same damage to other enemies hit.
spells.descriptionPt: Arremessa uma lança de gelo que se estilhaça ao atingir um inimigo, causando Dano Mágico e reduzindo sua Velocidade de Movimento. Os estilhaços atravessam o alvo, causando o mesmo dano a outros inimigos atingidos.
spells.tooltip: Lissandra throws a spear of ice that shatters on the first enemy hit, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage , Slowing them by {{ slowpercentage*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds, and also damaging and slowing the enemies behind them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ring of Frost
spells.description: Freezes nearby enemies in ice, dealing magic damage and rooting them.
spells.descriptionPt: Prende inimigos próximos em gelo, causando-lhes Dano Mágico e enraizando-os.
spells.tooltip: Lissandra creates an ice field, Rooting nearby enemies for {{ snareduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Glacial Path
spells.description: Lissandra creates an ice claw that deals magic damage. Reactivating this ability transports Lissandra to the claw's current location.
spells.descriptionPt: Lissandra cria uma garra de gelo que causa Dano Mágico. Reativar essa habilidade transporta Lissandra ao local atual da garra.
spells.tooltip: Lissandra casts forth an ice claw that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Lissandra can Recast while the claw travels to teleport to its location.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Frozen Tomb
spells.description: If cast on an enemy champion, the target is frozen solid, stunning it. If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable. Dark ice then emanates from the target dealing magic damage to enemies and slowing Move Speed.
spells.descriptionPt: Se conjurada em um Campeão inimigo, o alvo será congelado e atordoado. Se conjurada em Lissandra, ela se protege em um bloco de gelo sombrio, curando a si mesma enquanto fica inalvejável e invulnerável. Em seguida, o gelo sombrio emana a partir do alvo, causando Dano Mágico e reduzindo a Velocidade de Movimento de inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Lissandra encases herself or an enemy champion in ice. Enemies are Stunned for {{ enemycastduration }} seconds. When self cast, Lissandra enters Stasis for {{ selfcastduration }} seconds and restores {{ healamount }} Health , increased by {{ selfcastmissinghpratio }}% for each {{ selfcastmissinghpperabove }}% missing Health. In either case, dark ice eminates from the target, dealing {{ calculateddamage }} magic damage . The ice persists for {{ slowduration }} seconds, Slowing enemies by {{ slowamount*-100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Silver Stake
passive.description: Locke's attacks deal additional magic damage On-Hit, increased based on enemy missing Health.
passive.descriptionPt: Os Ataques de Locke causam Dano Mágico adicional ao contato, aumentado com base na Vida perdida do inimigo.

spells.name: Ritual Nails
spells.description: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing damage to and marking enemies hit. Locke can consume the marks to deal bonus damage with his attacks.
spells.descriptionPt: Locke prepara um conjunto de Pregos Anímicos para arremessar, causando dano e marcando os inimigos atingidos. Ele pode consumir as marcas para causar dano adicional com seus Ataques.
spells.tooltip: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing {{ missiledamage }} magic damage and marking enemies hit. Nails apply a {{ slowamount1*100 }}/{{ slowamount2*100 }}/{{ slowamount3*100 }}% Slow for {{ slowduration1 }}/{{ slowduration2 }}/{{ slowduration3 }} seconds, stacking with the amount of nails hit. Attacking the enemy consumes the Soul Nails , dealing {{ naildamage }} magic damage per stack, increased by {{ twomarkbonuspercent }}% and {{ threemarkbonuspercent }}% for two and three nails respectively.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Soul Ignition
spells.description: Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.
spells.descriptionPt: Locke incendeia a própria alma, recebendo Velocidade de Ataque e Velocidade de Movimento e causando dano a si mesmo. Ao final da duração, Locke recupera Vida com base em parte do dano sofrido durante o efeito.
spells.tooltip: Locke ignites his own soul, gaining {{ attackspeed }} Attack Speed and {{ movespeed }} Move Speed that decays over {{ decaytimehelper }} seconds. For {{ baseduration }} seconds, he suffers {{ healthcost*100 }}% current Health true damage per second but Heals back the last {{ damagerestoreamount }} damage taken, and an additional {{ additionalheal }} Health based on missing Health and time passed, up to a maximum of {{ maxhealingthreshold }} Health remaining . Can be Recast to end early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ashen Pursuit
spells.description: Locke teleports to a location before dashing to attack his next target, dealing damage to enemies passed through.
spells.descriptionPt: Locke se teleporta para um local e avança para atacar o próximo alvo, causando dano a inimigos no trajeto.
spells.tooltip: Locke teleports to a location, dealing {{ onhitdamage }} magic damage to nearby enemies on arrival. On his next Attack, he dashes to his target, dealing {{ dashdamage }} magic damage to all enemies in his path. Each hit consumes Soul Nails . If Locke scores a takedown, the Cooldown of this Ability is reset.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Purgatory
spells.description: Locke throws a binding artifact that deals damage and potentially executes enemies hit. Locke gains additional power for sealing away enemy champions.
spells.descriptionPt: Locke arremessa um artefato de restrição que causa dano e pode executar os inimigos atingidos. Locke ganha poder adicional ao aprisionar Campeões inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Locke throws a binding artifact to a location, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and Slowing enemies in the area by {{ slowamount*100 }}%, decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds. The artifact marks enemies hit for {{ duration }} seconds, sealing away marked enemy champions brought below {{ executetooltipcalc }} , and resetting the duration of the mark on other affected champions. After the duration ends, if at least one champion was sealed, the artifact lands on the ground. Locke can pick up the artifact to permanently increase its execution threshold by {{ executethresholdperstack*100 }}%, and refund {{ cooldownreduction }}% of his total Cooldown, for each champion sealed. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Lightslinger
passive.description: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.
passive.descriptionPt: Sempre que Lucian usa uma Habilidade, seu próximo Ataque se transforma em um disparo duplo. Quando Lucian é curado ou protegido por um aliado, ou quando um Campeão inimigo próximo é imobilizado, os próximos dois Ataques básicos dele causam Dano Mágico adicional.

spells.name: Piercing Light
spells.description: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.
spells.descriptionPt: Lucian faz um disparo de luz perfurante através de um alvo.
spells.tooltip: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ardent Blaze
spells.description: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Lucian dispara um projétil que explode em formato de estrela, marcando e revelando brevemente os inimigos. Ele recebe Velocidade de Movimento por atacar inimigos marcados.
spells.tooltip: Lucian fires a shot that explodes at the end of its range or on the first enemy hit, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage , briefly revealing enemies and marking them for 6 seconds. When Lucian or an ally damages a marked enemy, Lucian gains {{ movespeedamount }} Move Speed for 1 second. Allies triggering this effect will also grant Lucian Vigilance .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Relentless Pursuit
spells.description: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.
spells.descriptionPt: Lucian avança rapidamente uma curta distância. Disparo Iluminado reduz o Tempo de Recarga de Perseguição Implacável.
spells.tooltip: Lucian dashes. Cooldown is reduced by {{ cdrefundbase }} second whenever Lucian hits an enemy with Lightslinger ({{ cdrefundchampion }} seconds for champions). {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: The Culling
spells.description: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.
spells.descriptionPt: Lucian desfere uma torrente de disparos de suas armas.
spells.tooltip: Lucian rapidly fires {{ totalnumshots }} shots in a direction for {{ duration }} seconds or until he Recasts . Each shot deals {{ damageperbullet }} physical damage to the first enemy hit. While firing, Lucian may use Relentless Pursuit . Total Damage: {{ totaldamage }} physical damage {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
passive.description: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.
passive.descriptionPt: Pix faz disparos de energia mágica sempre que o Campeão que estiver seguindo atacar outra unidade inimiga. Os disparos seguem o inimigo, mas podem ser interceptados por outras unidades.

spells.name: Glitterlance
spells.description: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.
spells.descriptionPt: Pix e Lulu disparam um raio de energia mágica que causa dano e muita Lentidão aos inimigos atingidos.
spells.tooltip: Lulu and Pix each fire a piercing bolt dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*-100 }}%, decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds. Enemies take {{ bonusmissiledamage }} magic damage from additional bolts.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Whimsy
spells.description: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.
spells.descriptionPt: Se conjurada sobre um aliado, ela lhe concede Velocidade de Movimento por um curto período de tempo. Se lançado sobre um inimigo, ele é transformado em um adorável bichinho que não pode atacar nem lançar feitiços.
spells.tooltip: When used on an ally, Lulu grants {{ totalms }} Move Speed and {{ asbonus*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ msduration }} seconds. When used on an enemy, Lulu Polymorphs them for {{ ccduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Help, Pix!
spells.description: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.
spells.descriptionPt: Se conjurada em um aliado, ordena para que Pix pule nele e o proteja. Ela em seguida o segue e ajuda com seus ataques. Se conjurada em um inimigo, ordena para que Pix pule nele e o atinja. Ela o segue e lhe concede visão do inimigo.
spells.tooltip: When used on an ally, Pix jumps to them and grants Pix, Faerie Companion for {{ pixonallyduration }} seconds. If the ally is a champion, Pix also grants {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. When used on an enemy champion, Pix hampers them, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and granting True Sight of them for {{ pixonenemyduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Wild Growth
spells.description: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Lulu aumenta o tamanho de um aliado, arremessando ao ar inimigos próximos e concedendo ao aliado uma grande quantidade de Vida adicional. Pelos próximos segundos, tal aliado recebe uma aura que reduz a velocidade de inimigos próximos.
spells.tooltip: Lulu enlarges an ally, Knocking Up surrounding enemies for {{ knockbackduration }} second. The enlarged ally gains {{ totalbonushealth }} max Health and Slows surrounding enemies by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ buffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Illumination
passive.description: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for a few seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage (depending on Lux's level) to the target.
passive.descriptionPt: As habilidades de dano de Lux carregam o alvo com energia por alguns segundos. O próximo ataque de Lux incendeia a energia, causando Dano Mágico adicional (com base no nível de Lux) ao alvo.

spells.name: Light Binding
spells.description: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.
spells.descriptionPt: Lux atira uma esfera de luz que se prende e causa dano em até duas unidades inimigas.
spells.tooltip: Lux fires a ball of light, Rooting the first two enemies for {{ rootduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamagett }} magic damage to each.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Prismatic Barrier
spells.description: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.
spells.descriptionPt: Lux lança sua varinha e uma luz envolve todos os aliados atingidos, protegendo-os contra dano inimigo.
spells.tooltip: Lux throws her wand, granting {{ totalshieldtt }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds to allies it passes through. Then it returns, granting the same Shield on its return.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Lucent Singularity
spells.description: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.
spells.descriptionPt: Dispara uma luz irregular em uma área, reduzindo a velocidade de inimigos próximos. Lux pode detoná-la para causar dano aos inimigos na área de ação.
spells.tooltip: Lux creates a light zone that Slows by {{ slowpercent }}% and reveals the area. After {{ slowzoneduration }} seconds or on Recasting this Ability, it detonates, dealing {{ totaldamagett }} magic damage and Slowing for an additional {{ slowlingerduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Final Spark
spells.description: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area. In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.
spells.descriptionPt: Após acumular energia, Lux dispara um feixe de luz que causa dano a todos os inimigos na área. Além disso, ativa a habilidade passiva de Lux e reinicia a duração do efeito de Iluminação.
spells.tooltip: Lux fires a dazzling ray of light, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to all enemies in a line.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Granite Shield
passive.description: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.
passive.descriptionPt: Malphite está protegido por uma camada de rocha que absorve dano equivalente a até 10% de sua Vida máxima. Se Malphite não for atingido por alguns segundos, o efeito é recarregado.

spells.name: Seismic Shard
spells.description: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.
spells.descriptionPt: Malphite arremessa um fragmento de terra no inimigo através do chão, causando dano ao impacto e roubando Velocidade de Movimento por 3s.
spells.tooltip: Malphite launches a shard of earth at an enemy, dealing {{ qdamagecalc }} magic damage and Slowing them by {{ speedsteal }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Malphite also steals the amount Slowed , gaining it as Move Speed for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Thunderclap
spells.description: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.
spells.descriptionPt: Malphite ataca com tamanha força que cria uma onda sônica. Pelos próximos segundos, seus ataques criam ondas de choque em sua frente.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Malphite gains {{ bonusarmorpassive*100 }}% Armor (%i:scaleArmor%{{ f1 }}) . This effect is increased to {{ bonusarmorpassive*300 }}% (%i:scaleArmor%{{ f2 }}) while Granite Shield is active. Active: Malphite's next Attack deals an additional {{ totalbonusdamage }} physical damage and creates an aftershock which deals {{ thunderclapsplash }} physical damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit in their direction. His Attacks continue to create aftershocks %i:OnHit% On-Hit for the next {{ thunderclapbuffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ground Slam
spells.description: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.
spells.descriptionPt: Malphite golpeia o chão, enviando uma onda de choque que causa Dano Mágico com base em sua Armadura e reduz a Velocidade de Ataque dos inimigos por um curto período.
spells.tooltip: Malphite slams the ground, dealing {{ edamagecalc }} magic damage and reducing Attack Speed by {{ asreduction }}% for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Unstoppable Force
spells.description: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.
spells.descriptionPt: Malphite se arremessa em alta velocidade até um local, causando dano aos inimigos e Arremessando-os ao ar.
spells.tooltip: Malphite charges with the force of a landslide, dashing Unstoppably. At the end of the dash, Malphite Knocks Up for {{ knockupduration }} seconds and deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Void Shift
passive.description: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.
passive.descriptionPt: Caso não tenha sofrido dano ou efeitos de Controle de Grupo recentemente, Malzahar recebe uma enorme redução de dano e imunidade a Controles de Grupo, que duram um curto período após sofrer dano.

spells.name: Call of the Void
spells.description: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.
spells.descriptionPt: Malzahar abre dois portais para o Vazio. Depois de um breve intervalo, eles disparam projéteis que causam Dano Mágico e silenciam Campeões inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Malzahar opens two portals to the Void that fire projectiles inward, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage and Silencing for {{ silenceduration }} second(s).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Void Swarm
spells.description: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Malzahar invoca Voidlings para atacar inimigos próximos.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Malzahar's other Abilities give him a stack when cast (max {{ stackcap }}). Active: Malzahar summons a Voidling plus an additional Voidling per stack. Voidlings last {{ voidlingduration }} seconds and deal {{ voidlingbonusdamagetooltip }} magic damage each hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Malefic Visions
spells.description: Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time. Using Malzahar's other spells on the target will refresh the visions. If the target dies while afflicted by the visions, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit and Malzahar gains Mana. Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.
spells.descriptionPt: Malzahar infecta a mente de seu alvo com visões cruéis de sua própria morte, causando dano ao longo do tempo. Usar as outras habilidades de Malzahar no alvo reiniciará o efeito. Se o alvo for abatido enquanto afligido pelas visões, elas são transmitidas para uma unidade inimiga próxima e Malzahar recebe Mana. Os Voidlings de Malzahar são atraídos para as unidades afetadas.
spells.tooltip: Malzahar inflicts terrible visions, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage over {{ duration }} seconds. Applying Call of the Void or Nether Grasp to the victim during this time refreshes the visions. If the victim dies, Malzahar gains {{ manarestore }} Mana and the visions spread to the nearest enemy. Malefic Visions executes minions below {{ minionexecutethreshold }} Health. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Nether Grasp
spells.description: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.
spells.descriptionPt: Malzahar canaliza a essência do Vazio para suprimir o Campeão-alvo sobre uma área de energia negativa.
spells.tooltip: Malzahar Suppresses an enemy champion and deals {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage over {{ ccduration }} seconds. A zone of negative energy is created around his target dealing {{ zonedamagetooltip }} max Health magic damage over {{ poolduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Sap Magic
passive.description: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.
passive.descriptionPt: O ataque básico de Maokai também concede cura a ele e causa dano adicional com um Tempo de Recarga moderado. Sempre que ele conjurar uma habilidade ou for atingido por uma habilidade inimiga, o Tempo de Recarga da cura é reduzido.

spells.name: Bramble Smash
spells.description: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.
spells.descriptionPt: Maokai empurra inimigos próximos para trás com uma onda de choque, causando Dano Mágico e redução de velocidade.
spells.tooltip: Maokai smashes his fist into the ground, dealing {{ totaldamage }} plus {{ basepercenthealth*100 }}% max Health magic damage and briefly Slowing . Nearby enemies are also Knocked Back .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Twisted Advance
spells.description: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.
spells.descriptionPt: Maokai se transforma em uma massa de raízes ambulante, ficando inalvejável e avançando até o alvo. Ao chegar, ele enraíza o alvo.
spells.tooltip: Maokai transforms into a moving mass of roots, becoming Untargetable and dashing to an enemy. Upon arrival, he Roots the enemy for {{ rootduration }} second(s) and deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Sapling Toss
spells.description: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.
spells.descriptionPt: Maokai arremessa uma muda na área-alvo para ficar de guarda, sendo mais eficiente em arbustos.
spells.tooltip: Maokai flings a sapling, which stands watch for {{ saplingduration }} seconds. Saplings chase nearby enemies, detonating on arrival to deal {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slow surrounding enemies by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Sap Magic's Cooldown is reduced by an additional 4 seconds if the sapling hits an enemy champion or epic monster. If placed in brush, Saplings instead last for {{ empoweredsaplingduration }} seconds and cause a larger explosion, dealing {{ totalempowereddamage }} magic damage over {{ empowereddotduration }} seconds and Slowing enemies by {{ empoweredslowamount }}.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Nature's Grasp
spells.description: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.
spells.descriptionPt: Maokai invoca uma parede colossal de espinhos que avança lentamente, causando dano e enraizando inimigos no caminho.
spells.tooltip: Maokai summons a colossal wave of brambles and thorns, Rooting enemies for {{ minrootduration }} to {{ maxrootduration }} seconds, increasing with distance travelled, and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Hitting a champion gives Maokai {{ movehaste*100 }}% Move Speed , decaying over {{ hasteduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Double Strike
passive.description: Every few consecutive basic attack, Master Yi strikes twice.
passive.descriptionPt: A cada alguns ataques básicos consecutivos, Master Yi ataca duas vezes.

spells.name: Alpha Strike
spells.description: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.
spells.descriptionPt: Master Yi se teleporta pelo campo de batalha tão rápido que não pode ser visto, causando Dano Físico a várias unidades pelo caminho enquanto fica inalvejável. O Ataque Alpha pode causar Acerto Crítico e Dano Físico adicional contra monstros. Ataques básicos reduzem o Tempo de Recarga de Ataque Alpha.
spells.tooltip: Master Yi becomes Untargetable and teleports to rapidly strike enemies near his target, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to all enemies hit after {{ alphastrikebounces }} hits. This Ability can strike the same enemy repeatedly if there are no other targets, dealing {{ subsequenthitmultiplier*100 }}% damage for subsequent hits ( {{ subesquentdamage }} ), for a maximum single target total of {{ singletotaldamage }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Meditate
spells.description: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time. In addition, Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike and pause the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander for each second he channels.
spells.descriptionPt: Master Yi rejuvenesce seu corpo com a força da mente, restaurando Vida e recebendo dano reduzido por um curto período. Além disso, ele recebe acúmulos de Ataque Duplo e pausa a duração restante de Estilo Wuju e de Highlander para cada segundo de canalização.
spells.tooltip: Master Yi channels, restoring {{ totalheal }} Health over {{ healduration }} seconds. This healing is increased by up to {{ maxmissinghealthpercent*100 }}% based on Master Yi's missing Health. While channeling and for {{ drlinger }} seconds afterwards, he takes {{ initialdr }} reduced damage, decreased to {{ damagereduction*100 }}% after the first {{ initialextradrduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Wuju Style
spells.description: Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.
spells.descriptionPt: Concede Dano Verdadeiro adicional em ataques básicos.
spells.tooltip: Master Yi's Attacks deal an additional {{ totaldamage }} true damage for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Highlander
spells.description: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extend Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.
spells.descriptionPt: Master Yi se movimenta com extrema agilidade, aumentando temporariamente suas Velocidades de Ataque e de Movimento, tornando-se imune a todos os efeitos de Lentidão. Abates ou assistências de Campeões estendem a duração de Highlander enquanto a habilidade estiver ativa. Reduz passivamente o Tempo de Recarga das outras habilidades a cada abate ou assistência.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Champion takedowns reduce the remaining Cooldown of Master Yi's basic Abilities by {{ rcooldownrefund*100 }}%. Active: Master Yi enters a trance, gaining {{ rmsbonus }}% Move Speed , {{ rasbonus }}% Attack Speed , and immunity to Slows for {{ rduration }} seconds. Champion takedowns extend the duration of this Ability by {{ rkillassistextension }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Searing Brilliance
passive.description: Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack. When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.
passive.descriptionPt: Sempre que Mel usa uma habilidade, ela recebe três projéteis adicionais (até um máximo de nove) para o próximo ataque. Quando Mel causa dano com uma habilidade ou um ataque, ela aplica Deslumbrar, que pode acumular infinitamente. Se o inimigo for atingido por Mel com dano suficiente de Deslumbrar, os acúmulos serão consumidos para executar o alvo.

spells.name: Radiant Volley
spells.description: Mel fires a barrage of projectiles that explode around a target location, dealing damage repeatedly to enemies within the area.
spells.descriptionPt: Mel dispara uma saraivada de projéteis que explodem ao redor de um local-alvo, causando dano repetidamente aos inimigos dentro da área.
spells.tooltip: Mel unleashes a barrage of {{ explosioncount }} projectiles that explode in the area around a target location. The first explosion hit deals {{ initialexplosiondamage }} magic damage and each subsequent explosion deals {{ totalexplosiondamage }} magic damage , adding up to {{ alldamagehit }} magic damage total.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Rebuttal
spells.description: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed.
spells.descriptionPt: Mel envolve-se em uma barreira que reflete projéteis inimigos de volta para o atacante, evita sofrer dano e concede Velocidade de Movimento.
spells.tooltip: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects projectiles from enemy champions, gaining {{ shieldamount }} Shields for {{ duration }} seconds and {{ movespeed*100 }}% decaying Move Speed for {{ movespeedduration }} seconds. Reflected projectiles deal {{ damagepercent }} original damage as magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Solar Snare
spells.description: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.
spells.descriptionPt: Mel dispara um orbe radiante à frente, enraizando quem for pego no centro e causando Lentidão e dano ao longo do tempo aos inimigos na área ao redor.
spells.tooltip: Mel fires a radiating orb, Rooting enemies at its center for {{ rootduration }} seconds and dealing {{ damage }} magic damage . The orb builds up a hostile area around it that Slows enemies by {{ areaslowamount*100 }}% and deals {{ areadamagepersecond }} magic damage per second .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Golden Eclipse
spells.description: Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm. Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.
spells.descriptionPt: Mel ataca todos os inimigos marcados por Deslumbrar, independentemente da distância, causando dano adicional para cada acúmulo de Deslumbrar. O ranque de Eclipse Dourado aumenta o dano de Deslumbrar.
spells.tooltip: Passive : Overwhelm damage is increased to {{ passiveflatdamage }} magic damage plus {{ passivestackdamage }} magic damage per stack . Active : Mel unleashes her power on all enemies affected by Overwhelm , dealing {{ ultflatdamage }} magic damage plus {{ ultstackdamage }} magic damage per Overwhelm stack . Can only be cast when an enemy champion is affected by Overwhelm . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Fired Up!
passive.description: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.
passive.descriptionPt: As habilidades de Milio encantam aliados ao toque, fazendo com que o próximo ataque deles cause uma explosão de dano adicional e queime o alvo.

spells.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
spells.description: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.
spells.descriptionPt: Milio chuta uma bola que empurra um inimigo. A bola é lançada para cima ao contato e cai na direção do alvo, causando dano e Lentidão aos inimigos que estiverem na área atingida.
spells.tooltip: Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by {{ slowamountpercent }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Hitting at least one enemy champion with Ultra Mega Fire Kick refunds {{ refundratio*100 }}% of it's Mana cost.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Cozy Campfire
spells.description: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.
spells.descriptionPt: Cria uma zona fortalecida que cura aliados e aumenta o Alcance de Ataque de quem estiver dentro dela. A zona acompanha o aliado mais próximo do local de conjuração.
spells.tooltip: Milio creates a hearth that follows ally champions for {{ zoneduration }} seconds. Ally champions nearby gain {{ rangepercent }} Attack Range and restore {{ healingovertime }} Health over the duration. The hearth also applies Fired Up! every {{ healfrequencyseconds }} seconds. Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Warm Hugs
spells.description: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.
spells.descriptionPt: Milio concede um Escudo a um aliado, aumentando temporariamente a Velocidade de Movimento dele. Esta Habilidade tem 2 cargas.
spells.tooltip: Milio wraps an ally champion in protective flames, granting {{ shieldcalc }} Shield and {{ movespeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ movespeedduration }} seconds. This ability has 2 charges and the effects stack on repeat targets.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.description: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.
spells.descriptionPt: Milio libera uma onda de chamas reconfortantes que cura os aliados ao alcance, além de remover efeitos de controle de grupo.
spells.tooltip: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames on nearby ally champions, cleansing Disabling and Immobilizing effects, restoring {{ healcalc }} Health , and granting {{ tenacityamount*100 }}% Tenacity for {{ tenacityduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Love Tap
passive.description: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.
passive.descriptionPt: Miss Fortune causa Dano Físico adicional sempre que usar um ataque básico em um novo alvo.

spells.name: Double Up
spells.description: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap.
spells.descriptionPt: Miss Fortune dispara contra um inimigo, causando dano a ele e a um alvo atrás dele. Ambos os acertos também podem aplicar Batida do Amor.
spells.tooltip: Miss Fortune fires a bouncing shot, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} physical damage to an enemy and to another one behind them. The second shot can critically strike for {{ totaldamagecrit }} physical damage . It always critically strikes if the first shot kills its target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Strut
spells.description: Miss Fortune passively gains Move Speed when not attacked. This ability can be activated to grant bonus Attack Speed for a short duration. While it's on cooldown, Love Taps reduce the remaining cooldown of Strut.
spells.descriptionPt: Miss Fortune ganha Velocidade de Movimento passivamente quando não está sendo atacada. Esta habilidade pode ser ativada para conceder Velocidade de Ataque adicional por um curto período. Enquanto está em Tempo de Recarga, Batida do Amor reduz o Tempo de Recarga restante de Desfilando.
spells.tooltip: Passive: After {{ passivebasemsooc }} seconds of not taking damage, Miss Fortune gains {{ passivebasems }} Move Speed . After another {{ passivemaxmsextraooc }} seconds, this increases to {{ passivemaxms }} . Active: Gain the passive effect's full Move Speed bonus and {{ activeas*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ activeduration }} seconds. Love Taps reduce the Cooldown of this Ability by {{ lovetaprefund }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Make It Rain
spells.description: Miss Fortune reveals an area with a flurry of bullets, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.
spells.descriptionPt: Miss Fortune revela uma área com uma saraivada de balas, causando ondas de dano e reduzindo a velocidade dos oponentes.
spells.tooltip: Miss Fortune rains bullets, revealing an area, Slowing by {{ totalslowamount }} and dealing {{ totaldamagepersecond }} magic damage per second for {{ baseduration }} seconds (total {{ totaldamage }} magic damage ).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Bullet Time
spells.description: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies. Each wave of Bullet Time can critically strike
spells.descriptionPt: Miss Fortune canaliza uma saraivada de balas em formato de cone à sua frente, causando muito dano aos inimigos. Cada remessa de Metendo Bala pode causar Acerto Crítico.
spells.tooltip: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets, firing {{ basewaves }} waves over {{ basechannelduration }} seconds, dealing {{ physicaldamageperwave }} physical damage per wave (total {{ totalphysicaldamage }} physical damage ). Each wave can critically strike for %i:scaleCrit% {{ critdamageperwave }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Stone Skin
passive.description: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.
passive.descriptionPt: Wukong recebe Armadura e Regeneração de Vida máxima cumulativas quando luta contra Campeões e monstros.

spells.name: Crushing Blow
spells.description: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.
spells.descriptionPt: O próximo ataque de Wukong recebe Alcance de Ataque, causa dano adicional e reduz a Armadura do alvo por alguns segundos.
spells.tooltip: Wukong and his Clone's next Attack gains {{ attackrangebonus }} range, deals an additional {{ bonusdamagett }} physical damage , and removes {{ armorshredpercent*100 }}% Armor for {{ shredduration }} seconds. This Ability's cooldown is reduced by {{ cooldowndecrease }} seconds every time Wukong or his Clone hit an enemy with an Attack or Ability. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Warrior Trickster
spells.description: Wukong becomes Invisible and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Wukong fica Invisível e avança em uma direção, deixando para trás um clone que atacará inimigos próximos.
spells.tooltip: Wukong dashes and becomes Invisible for {{ stealthduration }} second, leaving behind a stationary Clone for {{ cloneduration }} seconds. The Clone Attacks nearby enemies Wukong has recently damaged and will mimic his ultimate, each dealing {{ clonedamagemod*100 }}% of normal damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Nimbus Strike
spells.description: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck.
spells.descriptionPt: Wukong avança em direção ao inimigo-alvo e conjura imagens de si próprio para atacar inimigos próximos, causando dano aos atingidos.
spells.tooltip: Wukong dashes to an enemy, sending out Clones that mimic the dash to up to {{ extratargets }} additional enemies nearby. Each enemy struck takes {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . He and his Clone gain {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ attackspeedduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Cyclone
spells.description: Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed. Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up.
spells.descriptionPt: Wukong estende seu cajado e gira repetidamente, recebendo Velocidade de Movimento. Inimigos atingidos sofrem dano e são arremessados ao ar.
spells.tooltip: Wukong gains {{ movespeed*100 }}% Move Speed and spins his staff, Knocking Up nearby enemies for {{ knockupduration }} seconds and take {{ totaldamagett }} plus {{ percenthpdamagett }} max Health physical damage over {{ spinduration }} seconds. This Ability can be cast a second time within {{ recastwindow }} seconds before going on cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Darkness Rise
passive.description: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.
passive.descriptionPt: Mordekaiser recebe uma poderosa aura de dano e Velocidade de Movimento depois de acertar 3 Ataques ou Habilidades contra Campeões inimigos ou monstros.

spells.name: Obliterate
spells.description: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.
spells.descriptionPt: Mordekaiser golpeia o chão com sua maça, causando dano a cada inimigo atingido. O dano é aumentado quando atingir um único inimigo.
spells.tooltip: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with Nightfall dealing {{ qdamage }} magic damage , increased to {{ empowereddamagetooltip }} if it hits only a single enemy.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Indestructible
spells.description: Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.
spells.descriptionPt: Mordekaiser armazena o dano que ele causa e recebe para criar um escudo. Ele pode consumir o escudo para se curar.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Mordekaiser stores {{ damageconversion*100 }}% of the damage he deals and {{ damagetakenconversion*100 }}% of the damage he takes. Active: Mordekaiser gains the stored damage as Shield . He may Recast this Ability to restore {{ healingpercent*100 }}% of the remaining Shield as Health . Minimum Shield: {{ minhealthtooltip }} Maximum Shield: {{ maxhealthtooltip }} {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Death's Grasp
spells.description: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.
spells.descriptionPt: Mordekaiser puxa todos os inimigos em uma área.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Mordekaiser gains {{ magicpen*100 }}% Magic Penetration . Active: Pulls enemies in his direction, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Realm of Death
spells.description: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.
spells.descriptionPt: Mordekaiser arrasta sua vítima com ele para uma dimensão diferente e rouba uma porção de seus atributos. Se abater sua vítima, ele mantém os atributos até que ela ressurja.
spells.tooltip: Mordekaiser banishes a champion to the Death Realm with him for {{ spiritrealmduration }}s, stealing {{ statstealpercentscalar*100 }}% of their core stats for the duration. If Mordekaiser kills that enemy in the Death Realm he consumes their soul, keeping the stats he stole until the target respawns.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Soul Siphon
passive.description: Morgana drains spirit from her enemies, healing as she deals damage to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungler monsters.
passive.descriptionPt: Morgana drena o espírito dos inimigos, curando-se conforme causa dano a Campeões, tropas grandes e monstros médios e grandes da selva.

spells.name: Dark Binding
spells.description: Morgana binds an enemy in place with dark magic, forcing them to feel the pain they've caused and dealing magic damage.
spells.descriptionPt: Morgana prende um inimigo no lugar com magia sombria, forçando-o a sentir a dor que provocou e causando Dano Mágico.
spells.tooltip: Morgana hurls a blast of starfire that Roots the first enemy hit for {{ rootduration }} seconds and deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tormented Shadow
spells.description: Morgana casts a cursed shadow on an area, damaging enemies who dare stand in her dark circle. They receive magic damage over time, which increases the lower health they are.
spells.descriptionPt: Morgana conjura uma sombra amaldiçoada em uma área, causando dano aos inimigos que ousarem permanecer em seu círculo sombrio. Eles sofrem Dano Mágico ao longo do tempo, que aumenta quanto mais suas Vidas estiverem baixas.
spells.tooltip: Morgana ignites the ground for {{ wduration }} seconds, dealing {{ totalmindamage }} magic damage per second, increased by up to {{ totalmaxdamage }} based on the targets' missing Health. This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by {{ cdrefundpercent*100 }}% every time Morgana is healed by Soul Siphon .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Black Shield
spells.description: Morgana anoints an ally with a protective barrier of starfire, which absorbs magical damage and disabling effects until it is broken.
spells.descriptionPt: Morgana abençoa um aliado com uma barreira protetora de fogo estelar que absorve Dano Mágico e efeitos de desarme até que quebre.
spells.tooltip: Morgana grants an ally champion {{ totalshieldstrength }} Magic Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. The shield prevents Disabling and Immobilizing effects until it breaks.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Soul Shackles
spells.description: Morgana unleashes the full force of her Celestial power as she unbinds her wings and hovers above the ground. She lashes chains of dark pain onto nearby enemy champions, gaining Move Speed. The chains slow and deal initial damage and, after a delay, stun those who are unable to break them.
spells.descriptionPt: Morgana libera a força total de seu poder celestial conforme desprende suas asas e flutua acima do chão. Ela lança correntes de dor sombria nos Campeões inimigos próximos, ganhando Velocidade de Movimento. As correntes causam Lentidão e um dano inicial. Depois de um intervalo, atordoam quem não conseguir quebrá-las.
spells.tooltip: Morgana chains herself to nearby enemy Champions, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing them by {{ slowpercent }}%. After {{ chainduration }} seconds, enemies unable to break the chains take an additional {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and are Stunned for {{ stunduration }} seconds. While casting this Ability, Morgana gains {{ hastepercent }}% Move Speed .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: We Are More
passive.description: Naafiri spawns packmates that attack the targets of her attacks and abilities.
passive.descriptionPt: Uma matilha surge e ataca os alvos dos ataques e habilidades de Naafiri.

spells.name: Darkin Daggers
spells.description: Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding. Packmates leap to attack the first champion or monster hit by this skill.
spells.descriptionPt: Naafiri arremessa até duas adagas; cada uma causa dano de sangramento ou, caso o alvo já esteja sangrando, dano adicional. A matilha avança para atacar o primeiro Campeão ou monstro atingido pela Habilidade.
spells.tooltip: Naafiri hurls Darkin-tainted blades, dealing {{ spell.naafiriq:totaldamagefirstcast }} physical damage and inflicting a bleed, dealing {{ spell.naafiriq:totalbleeddamage }} physical damage over {{ spell.naafiriq:bleedduration }} seconds. Naafiri can Recast this Ability. If enemies hit are already bleeding from this Ability, it instead deals the remaining bleed damage plus between {{ spell.naafiriq:totalmindamagesecondcast }} and {{ spell.naafiriq:totalmaxdamagesecondcast }} physical damage , based on their missing Health. If that target was a champion or large monster, Naafiri restores {{ spell.naafiriq:totalhealsecondcast }} Health . Packmates will leap at the first champion or monster hit and attack them for {{ spell.naafirip:packmatetauntduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: The Call of the Pack
spells.description: Naafiri becomes Untargetable and empowers her pack, spawning additional packmates and gaining increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.
spells.descriptionPt: Naafiri fica Inalvejável e fortalece sua matilha, fazendo surgir mais companheiros e recebendo Velocidade de Movimento e Dano de Ataque aumentados.
spells.tooltip: Naafiri becomes Untargetable for {{ untargetableduration }} second and prepares to hunt, spawning {{ packmatestoadd }} additional Packmates and gaining {{ bonusad }} Attack Damage and {{ movespeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ duration }} seconds. Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Eviscerate
spells.description: Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them.
spells.descriptionPt: Naafiri avança e causa dano a inimigos em uma área ao seu redor, evocando e curando totalmente sua matilha.
spells.tooltip: Naafiri surges forward, dealing {{ totaldamagefirstslash }} physical damage , then explodes in a flurry of blades, dealing {{ totaldamagesecondslash }} physical damage. Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri restoring 100% Health . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hounds' Pursuit
spells.description: Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, dealing damage. Naafiri reveals nearby enemies if she scores a takedown and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants a shield.
spells.descriptionPt: Naafiri e sua matilha avançam contra um Campeão, causando dano. Se conseguir uma eliminação, Naafiri revelará inimigos próximos e poderá reconjurar esta habilidade uma vez. A segunda conjuração concederá um Escudo.
spells.tooltip: Naafiri dashes at an enemy champion, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and briefly Slowing them. Packmates become Untargetable and dash alongside Naafiri, dealing {{ packmatedamage }} physical damage per Packmate . If Naafiri scores a Takedown within {{ takedownwindow }} seconds she reveals nearby enemies and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants {{ shieldtotal }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Surging Tides
passive.description: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.
passive.descriptionPt: Quando as Habilidades de Nami atingem Campeões aliados, eles recebem Velocidade de Movimento por um curto período.

spells.name: Aqua Prison
spells.description: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.
spells.descriptionPt: Lança uma bolha na área-alvo, causando dano e atordoando todos os inimigos ao impacto.
spells.tooltip: Nami hurls a bubble, Stunning for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamagett }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ebb and Flow
spells.description: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Desfere um jato de água que salta entre Campeões aliados e inimigos, curando os aliados e causando dano aos inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Nami unleashes a stream of water that bounces between allied and enemy champions. Each champion can only be hit once, and it hits up to {{ maxtargets }} targets. Restores {{ totalheal }} Health to allies and will bounce to a nearby enemy champion. Deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to enemies and will bounce to a nearby allied champion. The damage and healing value is modified by {{ bouncescaling }} each bounce. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
spells.description: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.
spells.descriptionPt: Fortalece um Campeão aliado por uma curta duração. Os ataques básicos e habilidades do aliado causam Dano Mágico adicional e reduzem a velocidade do alvo.
spells.tooltip: Nami empowers an allied champion's next {{ hitcount }} Attacks and Abilities for {{ buffduration }} seconds, causing them to Slow their targets by {{ totalslow }} for {{ slowduration }}s and deal an additional {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tidal Wave
spells.description: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.
spells.descriptionPt: Invoca uma grande Maré Violenta que arremessa ao ar, reduz a velocidade e causa dano aos inimigos atingidos. Aliados atingidos recebem o efeito dobrado de Maré Oscilante.
spells.tooltip: Nami summons a tidal wave, Knocking Up for 0.5 seconds, Slowing by {{ slowamount }}%, and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . The duration of the Slow increases based on distance the wave traveled, up to {{ maxslowduration }} seconds. Allies hit by the wave gain double the effect of Surging Tides .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Soul Eater
passive.description: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Life Steal.
passive.descriptionPt: Nasus drena a energia espiritual de seu inimigo, acumulando Roubo de Vida adicional.

spells.name: Siphoning Strike
spells.description: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.
spells.descriptionPt: Nasus ataca seu inimigo, causando dano e aumentando o poder do próximo Ataque Sifão se o alvo for abatido.
spells.tooltip: Nasus' next Attack deals {{ totaldamage }} physical damage . Killing an enemy with this Attack permanently increases its damage by {{ basicstacks }}, increased to {{ bigstacks }} against champions, large minions and large jungle monsters.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Wither
spells.description: Nasus ages an enemy champion, decelerating their Move Speed and Attack Speed over time.
spells.descriptionPt: Nasus envelhece um Campeão inimigo, reduzindo a Velocidade de Movimento e de Ataque do alvo ao longo do tempo.
spells.tooltip: Nasus ages a champion, Slowing them by {{ slowbase }}%, increasing to {{ maxslowtooltiponly }}% over {{ duration }} seconds. Their Attack Speed is also reduced by {{ attackspeedslowmult*100 }}% of the Slow .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spirit Fire
spells.description: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.
spells.descriptionPt: Nasus libera uma chama espiritual em um local, causando dano e reduzindo a Armadura dos inimigos que pisarem nela.
