Hitting an enemy who's already Slowed by this Ability increases the Slow to {{ empoweredslowamount }}% and reduces the enemy's Magic Resist by {{ enhancedmagicpen*100 }}% Danger Zone: The harpoon deals {{ empdamage }} magic damage instead and the Slow and reduced Magic Resist are increased by 50%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: The Equalizer
spells.description: Rumble fires off a group of rockets, creating a wall of flames that damages and slows enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Rumble dispara um grupo de mísseis, criando uma parede de fogo que causa dano e Lentidão a inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Rumble launches a line of rockets, creating a burning trail that lasts {{ trailduration }} seconds, Slowing by {{ slowamount }}% and dealing {{ damagepersecond }} magic damage per second. Rumble can control the direction of the trail by clicking and dragging while casting this Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Arcane Mastery
passive.description: Ryze's spells deal extra damage based on his Bonus Mana, and he gains a percentage increase to his maximum Mana based on his Ability Power.
passive.descriptionPt: As habilidades de Ryze causam dano adicional com base em seu Mana adicional. Ele recebe um percentual de aumento de Mana máximo com base em seu Poder de Habilidade.

spells.name: Overload
spells.description: Passively, Ryze's other basic abilities reset the cooldown of Overload and charge a rune. When Ryze casts Overload with 2 runes charged, he gains a brief burst of Move Speed. On cast, Ryze throws a charge of pure energy in a line, dealing damage to the first enemy struck. If the target has Flux on it, Overload deals extra damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.
spells.descriptionPt: Passivamente, as outras habilidades básicas de Ryze redefinem o Tempo de Recarga de Sobrecarregar e carregam uma runa. Quando Ryze conjura Sobrecarregar com 2 runas carregadas, ele recebe um breve surto de Velocidade de Movimento. Ao conjurar, Ryze arremessa uma carga de energia pura em linha reta, causando dano ao primeiro inimigo atingido. Se o alvo estiver afetado por Fluxo, Sobrecarregar causa dano adicional e rebate para inimigos próximos atingidos por Fluxo.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Rune Prison and Spell Flux refresh this Ability's Cooldown and charge a rune for {{ runeduration }} seconds (max {{ maximumrunes }} runes). Active: Ryze unleashes a blast, dealing {{ qdamagecalc }} magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the target has Flux on it, it is consumed, causing this Ability to deal {{ spell.ryzer:overloaddamagebonus }}% increased damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux . Ryze also discharges all runes, granting Ryze {{ movementspeedamount }}% Move Speed for {{ movementspeedduration }} seconds if {{ maximumrunes }} runes were charged. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Rune Prison
spells.description: Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.
spells.descriptionPt: Ryze prende um alvo em uma prisão de runas, causando dano e reduzindo sua Velocidade de Movimento. Se o alvo estiver afetado por Fluxo, ele é enraizado.
spells.tooltip: Ryze deals {{ wdamagecalc }} magic damage and Slows by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ ccduration }} seconds. If the target has Flux , it is consumed and this Ability Roots instead of Slowing .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spell Flux
spells.description: Ryze releases an orb of pure magical power that damages an enemy and debuffs all nearby enemies. Ryze's spells have additional effects against the debuffed enemy.
spells.descriptionPt: Ryze lança um orbe de puro poder mágico que causa dano a um inimigo e um efeito negativo em todos os inimigos próximos. As habilidades de Ryze têm efeitos adicionais contra a unidade afetada.
spells.tooltip: Ryze fires an orb, dealing {{ edamagecalc }} magic damage and applies Flux for {{ debuffduration }} seconds to the target and nearby enemies. Enemies already afflicted with Flux will cause it to spread further.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Realm Warp
spells.description: Passively, Overload deals even more damage against targets with Flux. On cast, Ryze creates a portal to a nearby location. After a few seconds, allies standing near the portal are teleported to the target location.
spells.descriptionPt: Passivamente, Sobrecarregar causa ainda mais dano contra alvos afetados por Fluxo. Ao conjurar, Ryze cria um portal para um local próximo. Após alguns segundos, aliados próximos ao portal são teleportados ao local alvo.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Overload damage bonus against targets with Flux increased to {{ overloaddamagebonus }}%. Active: Ryze opens a portal to another location. After {{ chargetimetooltip }} seconds, all allies near the portal are teleported to that location.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Daredevil Impulse
passive.description: Samira builds a combo by hitting attacks or abilities unique from the previous hit. Samira's attacks in melee range deal additional magic damage. Samira's attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her attack range. If the enemy is Knocked Up , she also keeps them Knocked Up briefly.
passive.descriptionPt: Samira gera um combo conforme Ataca ou conjura habilidades de forma alternada. Seus Ataques corpo a corpo causam Dano Mágico adicional. Os Ataques de Samira contra inimigos sob efeitos Imobilizadores a farão avançar ao Alcance de Ataque dela. Se o inimigo estiver afetado por Arremesso ao ar , ela mantém o Arremesso ao ar por um curto período.

spells.name: Flair
spells.description: Samira fires a shot or swings her sword, dealing damage. If cast during Wild Rush, strike all enemies in her path upon completion.
spells.descriptionPt: Samira dispara um projétil ou golpeia com a espada, causando dano. Se a habilidade for conjurada durante Ímpeto Indomável, ela atinge todos os inimigos no caminho.
spells.tooltip: Samira fires a shot, dealing {{ damagecalc }} physical damage to the first enemy hit. If this Ability is cast towards an enemy in melee range, Samira will instead slash with her sword, dealing {{ damagecalc }} physical damage . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Blade Whirl
spells.description: Samira slashes around her, damaging enemies and destroying enemy missiles.
spells.descriptionPt: Samira gira a espada ao seu redor, causando dano e destruindo projéteis inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Samira slashes around her for {{ slashduration }} seconds, damaging enemies twice for {{ damagecalc }} physical damage each and destroying any enemy missiles that enter the area. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Wild Rush
spells.description: Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through and gaining Attack Speed. Killing an enemy champion refreshes this ability's cooldown.
spells.descriptionPt: Samira avança e atravessa um inimigo (incluindo estruturas), cortando os inimigos atravessados e recebendo Velocidade de Ataque. Abater um Campeão inimigo reinicia o Tempo de Recarga da habilidade.
spells.tooltip: Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through dealing {{ dashdamage }} magic damage and gaining {{ bonusattackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ attackspeedduration }} seconds. If an enemy champion is killed within 3 seconds of Samira damaging them, This Ability's Cooldown is reset.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Inferno Trigger
spells.description: Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her.
spells.descriptionPt: Samira dispara uma saraivada de tiros, atingindo todos os inimigos ao redor dela.
spells.tooltip: Samira can only use this Ability if her current Style rating is S. Using this Ability consumes all Style rating. Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her 10 times over 2 seconds, each shot dealing {{ damagecalc }} physical damage and applying Life Steal at {{ lifestealmod*100 }}% effectiveness. Each shot can also critically strike.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Fury of the North
passive.description: After being out of combat, Sejuani gains Frost Armor which grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows. Frost Armor persists for a short time after Sejuani takes damage. Sejuani can damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage.
passive.descriptionPt: Após ficar fora de combate, Sejuani recebe Armadura Congelada, que concede Armadura, Resistência Mágica e imunidade a reduções de velocidade. Armadura Congelada persiste por um curto período após Sejuani sofrer dano e Sejuani pode causar dano a um inimigo atordoado para estilhaçá-la, causando muito Dano Mágico.

spells.name: Arctic Assault
spells.description: Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air. The charge stops after hitting an enemy champion.
spells.descriptionPt: Sejuani avança em investida, lançando os inimigos pelos ares. A investida cessa após acertar um Campeão inimigo.
spells.tooltip: Sejuani charges, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage to enemies and Knocking them Up for {{ knockupdurationtooltiponly }} seconds. The charge ends after hitting an enemy champion.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Winter's Wrath
spells.description: Sejuani swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks.
spells.descriptionPt: Sejuani usa a maça duas vezes, causando dano e aplicando acúmulos de Congelar.
spells.tooltip: Sejuani swings her flail, dealing {{ firsthitdamagetooltip }} physical damage and Knocking Back minions and jungle monsters. She then lashes out again, dealing {{ secondhitdamagetooltip }} physical damage and briefly Slowing targets. Both swings apply stacks of Permafrost .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Permafrost
spells.description: Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.
spells.descriptionPt: Sejuani congela e atordoa um Campeão inimigo que tiver o máximo de acúmulos de Congelar.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Nearby melee allied champions' Attacks apply a stack to champions and jungle monsters. Active: Sejuani deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to target enemy with 4 stacks and Stuns them for {{ ccduration }} second. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Glacial Prison
spells.description: Sejuani throws her bola that freezes and stuns the first champion hit and creates an ice storm that slows other enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Sejuani arremessa sua boleadeira, congelando e atordoando o primeiro Campeão que acertar, criando uma tempestade de gelo que causa lentidão aos demais inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Sejuani throws her True Ice bola, Stunning and revealing the first enemy champion hit for {{ basestunduration }} second and dealing {{ minordamagetooltip }} magic damage . If the bola travels at least 25% of its range, it Stuns and reveals for {{ empoweredstunduration }} seconds instead. It then also creates an ice storm that Slows surrounding enemies by {{ explosionslowamount }}% for {{ zoneduration }} seconds. All affected enemies take {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Absolution
passive.description: When units die near Senna, their souls are periodically trapped by the Black Mist. Senna can attack these souls to free them, absorbing the Mist that held them in death. Mist fuels her Relic Cannon's power with increased Attack Damage, Attack Range, and Critical Strike Chance. Attacks from Senna's Relic Cannon take longer to fire, deal bonus damage, and briefly grant her a portion of her target's Move Speed.
passive.descriptionPt: Quando unidades são abatidas perto de Senna, suas almas são periodicamente aprisionadas na Névoa Negra. Senna pode atacar essas almas para libertá-las, absorvendo a Névoa que as aprisiona na morte. A Névoa é o combustível do poder de seu Canhão Relicário, alimentando-o com Dano de Ataque, Alcance de Ataque e Chance de Acerto Crítico. Ataques do Canhão Relicário de Senna demoram mais para disparar, causam dano adicional e concedem a ela brevemente uma parte da Velocidade de Movimento do alvo.

spells.name: Piercing Darkness
spells.description: From the twin barrels of her Relic Cannon, Senna fires a unified beam of light and shadow through a target, healing allies and damaging enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Dos canos gêmeos de seu Canhão Relicário, Senna dispara um raio unificado de luz e sombra através do alvo, curando aliados e causando dano a inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Senna shoots a bolt of piercing shadow through an ally or enemy, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to enemies and Slowing them by {{ totalslow }} for {{ slowduration }} second(s). Restores {{ totalheal }} Health to allied champions. Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ cdreductiononhit }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Last Embrace
spells.description: Senna sends forth a wave of Black Mist. If it hits an enemy it latches onto them hungrily, rooting them and everything nearby after a brief delay.
spells.descriptionPt: Senna dispara uma onda de Névoa Negra. Se atingir um inimigo, ela o aprisiona ferozmente, enraizando o alvo e tudo que estiver ao redor dele após um curto intervalo.
spells.tooltip: Senna sends forth the Black Mist, dealing {{ damage }} physical damage to the first enemy hit. After a {{ delaytime }} second delay the target and other nearby enemies are Rooted for {{ rootduration }} second(s).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Curse of the Black Mist
spells.description: Senna draws the Mist she has stored in her weapon into a storm around her, embracing darkness and becoming a wraith within. Allies who enter the area are camouflaged and also appear as wraiths as the Mist shrouds them. Wraiths gain increased Move Speed, are unselectable, and hide their identities.
spells.descriptionPt: Senna reúne a Névoa que ela armazenou em sua arma e a transforma em uma tempestade ao seu redor, abraçando a escuridão e se tornando um espectro. Os aliados que entram na área são camuflados e também tomam a forma de espectros enquanto a Névoa os envolve. Espectros têm sua Velocidade de Movimento aumentada, são inalvejáveis e escondem a própria identidade.
spells.tooltip: Senna dissolves into a cloud of Black Mist for {{ buffduration }} seconds, becoming a Wraith. Allied champions who enter the Mist are Camouflaged and become Wraiths when they leave. Wraiths gain {{ totalms }} Move Speed , are Unselectable, and hide their identities as long as no enemy champions are nearby.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Dawning Shadow
spells.description: Senna calls upon the relic stones of fallen Sentinels, splitting her relic cannon into a holy array of shadow and light. She then fires a global beam that shields allies from harm, while damaging enemies caught in the center.
spells.descriptionPt: Senna invoca as pedras relicárias dos Sentinelas caídos, dividindo seu canhão relicário em uma miríade de luz e sombra. Ela, então, dispara um raio global que concede escudo a aliados, enquanto causa dano aos inimigos atingidos no centro.
spells.tooltip: Senna fires a beam of light that deals {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to all enemy champions hit. Allied champions hit in a wider area receive {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Stage Presence
passive.description: Every third basic spell will cast twice from Seraphine. Additionally, casting spells near allies grants her bonus magic damage and range on her next basic attack.
passive.descriptionPt: Cada terceira habilidade básica será conjurada duas vezes por Seraphine. Conjurar habilidades próximas a aliados também concede dano e alcance adicionais a ela no próximo ataque básico.

spells.name: High Note
spells.description: Seraphine deals damage in an area.
spells.descriptionPt: Seraphine causa dano em uma área.
spells.tooltip: Seraphine projects a pure note, dealing {{ explosiondamage }} magic damage , increased against champions and monsters by the target's missing Health percentage up to {{ totalempowereddamage }} damage below {{ executethreshold*100 }}% Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Surround Sound
spells.description: Seraphine Shields and Hastes nearby allies. If she is already Shielded she will Heal nearby allies as well.
spells.descriptionPt: Seraphine concede Escudo e Aceleração aos aliados próximos. Caso ela já esteja protegida por um Escudo, também Curará os aliados próximos.
spells.tooltip: Seraphine spurs her nearby allied champions in song, granting them {{ hastevalueallies }} Move Speed , herself {{ wmsbonustotal }} decaying Move Speed and both {{ shieldvalueseraphine }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. If Seraphine is already Shielded , she calls out to her allies to join her, restoring {{ wmissinghpheal }}% missing Health to them after a {{ whealsplitdelay }} second delay.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Beat Drop
spells.description: Seraphine deals damage and impairs the movement of enemies in a line.
spells.descriptionPt: Seraphine causa dano e debilita o movimento dos inimigos em linha reta.
spells.tooltip: Seraphine unleashes a heavy soundwave, dealing {{ finaldamage }} magic damage to enemies in a line and Slowing them by {{ slowvalue }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Enemies that are already Slowed are Rooted instead, and Immobilized enemies are Stunned .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Encore
spells.description: Seraphine deals damage and charms enemies hit, refreshing the range with every allied or enemy champion hit.
spells.descriptionPt: Seraphine causa dano e Encanta os inimigos atingidos, ampliando o alcance a cada Campeão aliado ou inimigo atingido.
spells.tooltip: Seraphine takes the stage, projecting a captivating force that Charms for {{ rchannelduration }} seconds and deals {{ r1totaldamage }} magic damage . Any champions struck (including allies) become part of the performance, extending the range of this Ability. Allied champions gain maximum Notes .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Pit Grit
passive.description: Sett's basic attacks alternate between left and right punch. Right punch is slightly stronger and faster. Sett also hates losing, gaining additional health regeneration based off of his missing health.
passive.descriptionPt: Os ataques básicos de Sett alternam entre socos de direita e esquerda. Socos de direita são levemente mais fortes e rápidos. Como Sett odeia perder, recebe Regeneração de Vida adicional com base na Vida perdida.

spells.name: Knuckle Down
spells.description: Sett's next two attacks deal additional damage based off of the target's max health. Sett also gains Move Speed while moving towards enemy champions.
spells.descriptionPt: Os próximos dois ataques de Sett causam dano adicional com base na Vida máxima do alvo. Ele também recebe Velocidade de Movimento enquanto se move em direção a Campeões inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Sett itches for a fight, gaining {{ msamount*100 }}% Move Speed towards enemy champions for {{ msduration }} seconds. Additionally Sett's next two Attacks deal an additional {{ basedamage }} plus {{ maxhealthdamagecalc }} max Health physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Haymaker
spells.description: Sett passively stores damage he takes as Grit. On cast, Sett expends all stored Grit to gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides.
spells.descriptionPt: O dano que Sett sofre é armazenado passivamente como Ousadia. Ao conjurar a habilidade, Sett consome toda a Ousadia armazenada em troca de um escudo e desfere um soco em uma área, causando Dano Verdadeiro no centro e Dano Físico nas laterais.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Sett stores {{ damagestored*100 }}% of damage taken as Grit , up to {{ maxgrit }} . Grit decays quickly {{ adrenalinestoragewindow }} seconds after the damage was taken. Active: Sett consumes all Grit , gaining a {{ shieldconversion*100 }}% Grit consumed Shield decaying over {{ shieldmaxduration }} seconds. Sett then delivers a massive punch, dealing {{ damagecalc }} plus {{ damageconversion }} Grit consumed true damage to enemies in the center (max {{ f1 }} damage ). Enemies not in the center instead take physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Facebreaker
spells.description: Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.
spells.descriptionPt: Sett puxa todos os inimigos de cada lado seu, causando dano e atordoando. Caso haja inimigos somente de um lado, eles sofrem redução de velocidade em vez de atordoamento.
spells.tooltip: Sett smashes enemies on either side of him into each other, dealing {{ damagecalc }} physical damage and Slowing them by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. If Sett grabbed at least one enemy on each side, all enemies are Stunned for {{ stunduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: The Show Stopper
spells.description: Sett carries an enemy champion through the air and slams them into the ground, dealing damage and slowing all enemies near where they land.
spells.descriptionPt: Sett carrega um Campeão inimigo pelos ares e o arremessa no chão, causando dano e redução de velocidade a todos os inimigos que estiverem próximos ao local de aterrissagem.
spells.tooltip: Sett grabs an enemy champion and Suppresses them as he carries them forward, then slams them into the ground, dealing {{ damagecalc }} plus {{ maxhealthdamage*100 }}% of the grabbed enemy's bonus Health physical damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} second. Enemies take less damage the further they are from where Sett lands.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Backstab
passive.description: Shaco's basic attacks and Two-Shiv Poison deal additional damage when striking from behind.
passive.descriptionPt: Os ataques básicos de Shaco e Veneno de Dois Gumes causam dano adicional ao atingirem o inimigo por trás.

spells.name: Deceive
spells.description: Shaco becomes Invisible and teleports to target location. His first attack while Invisible is empowered, dealing bonus damage and critically striking if he attacks from behind.
spells.descriptionPt: Shaco fica Invisível e se teleporta para o local-alvo. Seu primeiro ataque enquanto está Invisível é fortalecido, causando dano adicional e crítico ao atingir o inimigo por trás.
spells.tooltip: Shaco teleports and becomes Invisible for {{ stealthduration }} seconds. Using Jack In The Box or Hallucinate does not break Invisibility . Shaco's next Attack while Invisible deals an additional {{ totaldamage }} physical damage . If striking from behind, this Attack critically strikes for {{ qcritdamagemod }} damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Jack In The Box
spells.description: Shaco creates a hidden animated Jack-in-the-Box. When triggered, it will fear and attack nearby enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Shaco cria uma Caixinha-Surpresa escondida. Quando ativada, ela causará temor e atacará inimigos próximos.
spells.tooltip: Shaco creates a trap that stealths itself after {{ armtime }} seconds and lasts for {{ trapduration }} seconds. It activates when an enemy comes near or when revealed, Fearing nearby enemy Champions for {{ fearduration }} seconds, or {{ minionfearduration }} seconds for minions and jungle monsters. Once activated, the trap fires at all nearby enemies for 5 seconds, dealing {{ aoedamage }} magic damage , or {{ stdamage }} damage if focused on a single target. Jack in the Box's attacks deal an additional {{ monsterbonusdamage }} damage to monsters.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Two-Shiv Poison
spells.description: Shaco's Shivs passively poison targets on hit, slowing their Move Speed. He can throw his Shivs to deal damage and poison the target. The thrown Shiv deals bonus damage if the target is below 30% health.
spells.descriptionPt: As facas de Shaco envenenam alvos passivamente ao contato, reduzindo sua Velocidade de Movimento. Ele pode arremessá-las para causar dano e envenenar o alvo. A faca arremessada causa dano adicional se a Vida do alvo estiver abaixo de 30%.
spells.tooltip: Passive: While this Ability is off Cooldown, Shaco's Attacks Slow the target by {{ slowamount*-100 }}% for {{ slowdurationpassive }} seconds. Active: Shaco throws a shiv, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*-100 }}% for {{ slowdurationactive }} seconds. If the target has less than {{ executehealththreshold*100 }}% Health, the shiv deals {{ totalexecutedamage }} damage instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hallucinate
spells.description: Shaco creates an illusion of himself near him, which can attack nearby enemies (Deals reduced damage to turrets). Upon death, it explodes, spawning three mini Jack in the Boxes and dealing damage to nearby enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Shaco cria uma ilusão de si mesmo próxima a ele, que pode atacar inimigos próximos (causa dano reduzido a torres). Ao morrer, ela explode, fazendo surgir três Caixinhas-Surpresa e causando dano a todos os inimigos próximos.
spells.tooltip: Shaco briefly disappears, then reappears with a clone that lasts {{ clonelifetime }} seconds and detonates when it dies, dealing {{ explosiontotaldamage }} magic damage and spawning three mini Jack in the Boxes that trigger immediately. The clone deals {{ cloneaadamagepercent*100 }}% of Shaco's damage and receives {{ cloneincomingdamagepercent*100 }}% increased damage. Mini Jack in the Boxes deal {{ aoedamage }} magic damage , or {{ stdamage }} magic damage if firing at only one enemy, and Fear for {{ boxfearduration }} second. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Ki Barrier
passive.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.
passive.descriptionPt: Após conjurar uma habilidade, Shen recebe um escudo. Afetar outros Campeões reduz o Tempo de Recarga desse efeito.

spells.name: Twilight Assault
spells.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.
spells.descriptionPt: Shen chama sua espada espiritual para atacar com ela, causando dano com base na Vida máxima do alvo. Os ataques são fortalecidos drasticamente caso ela colida com um Campeão inimigo. Todos os Campeões com quem ela colide têm a velocidade reduzida enquanto fogem de Shen.
spells.tooltip: Shen recalls his Spirit Blade . Enemies hit by the pull are Slowed by {{ slowpercent }}% while moving away from Shen for the next {{ slowduration }} seconds. Additionally, Shen's next {{ numenhancedattacks }} Attacks deal an additional {{ baseflatdamage }} plus {{ basepercenthealth }} max Health magic damage . If Shen hit an enemy champion with the Spirit Blade , the damage is increased to {{ baseflatdamage }} plus {{ emppercenthealth }} max Health magic damage and he gains {{ steroidas }}% Attack Speed for those Attacks.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spirit's Refuge
spells.description: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.
spells.descriptionPt: Ataques que atingiriam Shen ou seus aliados próximos à sua espada espiritual são bloqueados.
spells.tooltip: Shen creates a defensive zone at his Spirit Blade for {{ zoneduration }} seconds. Attacks against allied champions in the zone are blocked. If there are no champions to protect in the zone when it starts, it will wait for up to {{ zonedelay }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Shadow Dash
spells.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.
spells.descriptionPt: Shen avança em uma direção, provocando inimigos em seu trajeto.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Dealing damage with Twilight Assault or this Ability recovers {{ energyrefund }} Energy . Active: Shen dashes, Taunting champions and jungle monsters for {{ ccduration }} seconds and dealing {{ tauntdamage }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Stand United
spells.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.
spells.descriptionPt: Shen protege o Campeão-alvo aliado do dano recebido e, em seguida, teleporta-se para seu local.
spells.tooltip: Shen grants an allied champion anywhere on the map between {{ shield }} and {{ maxshield }} Shield based on their missing Health for {{ shieldduration }} seconds (max Shield at 60% missing Health). After channeling for {{ channelduration }} seconds, Shen teleports to his ally's location with his Spirit Blade .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Scalemail
passive.description: Takedowns on enemy champions, large minions, and large monsters grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses.
passive.descriptionPt: Eliminar Campeões inimigos, tropas grandes e monstros grandes concede a Shyvana acúmulos de Armadura de Escamas, melhorando suas defesas.

spells.name: Emberstrike
spells.description: Shyvana's next attack strikes both the target and the surrounding area. This Ability can be recast. While in Dragon Form, it gains an additional recast, dealing massive damage to a single target.
spells.descriptionPt: O próximo ataque de Shyvana atinge tanto o alvo quanto a área ao redor. A Habilidade pode ser reconjurada. Quando assume a Forma de Dragão, ela ganha uma reconjuração adicional, causando muito dano a um único alvo.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Shyvana's Attacks deal {{ calc_max_health_damage }} max Health magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit and reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ cooldown_reduction }} seconds. Active: Shyvana's next Attack strikes the target and the surrounding area dealing {{ calc_damage }} physical damage . This Ability may be Recast after an Attack or short delay within the next {{ recastduration }} seconds. Dragon Form: Shyvana gains an additional Recast , causing her to bite the target of her next Attack dealing {{ calc_dragon_form_damage }} true damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Inferno Aegis
spells.description: Shyvana gains a shield, movement speed, and after a short delay, the area around her detonates. While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.
spells.descriptionPt: Shyvana recebe Escudo e Velocidade de Movimento. Depois de um curto intervalo, a área ao redor dela detona. Durante a Forma de Dragão, a explosão a curará se atingir um Campeão inimigo.
spells.tooltip: Shyvana wraps herself in flames for {{ duration }} seconds, gaining {{ calc_shield }} Shield , increased by {{ calc_shield_per_nearby_champion }} per nearby enemy champion and {{ movespeed }} Move Speed , increased to {{ movespeedtowardsenemies }} when moving towards enemy champions. When the effect ends, the Shield is broken, or upon Recast the area around her detonates, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage . Dragon Form: If the detonation hits an enemy champion Shyvana heals for {{ calc_base_heal }} + {{ calc_missing_health_heal }} Missing Health .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Molten Burst
spells.description: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.
spells.descriptionPt: Shyvana lança uma bola de fogo que explode ao atingir um alvo grande, causando Lentidão. Na Forma de Dragão, ela atravessa e explode ao atingir inimigos grandes, deixando um rastro de fogo por onde passa.
spells.tooltip: Shyvana launches a fireball at the target location dealing {{ damage }} + {{ calc_max_health_damage }} Max health magic damage and Slowing by {{ calc_slow }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds . It explodes upon striking an enemy or reaching its terminus. Dragon Form: Shyvana's fireball is larger and pierces through enemies. Upon striking a champion, large monster, or reaching its terminus it triggers a pulse of fire that deals {{ calc_dragon_damage }} + {{ calc_max_health_dragon_damage }} Max Health magic damage and Slows by {{ calc_slow_dragon }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds . The fireball leaves behind a trail for {{ groundlingerduration }} seconds that deals {{ damagepersecond }} magic damage per second . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Dragon's Descent
spells.description: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.
spells.descriptionPt: Shyvana se transforma em um Dragão e avança, fazendo os inimigos no caminho fugirem. Durante a Forma de Dragão, ela fica maior e suas habilidades básicas são fortalecidas.
spells.tooltip: Passive : Shyvana generates {{ fury_generation }} Dragon Fury by striking enemies with Attacks and Abilities, increased by {{ tt_fury_mult }} while in Dragon Form , and reduced {{ tt_fury_aoe_penalty }} by when striking in an area against non-champions. Active : Shyvana transforms into her Dragon Form , becoming Unstoppable , and flying to the target location breathing fire on enemies below dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and causing them Flee for {{ fearduration }} seconds . While transformed, Shyvana's basic Abilities are upgraded, she gains {{ calc_bonus_health }} bonus Health , size, and Attack Range. Shyvana loses Dragon Fury over time and her transformation ends when she has no Dragon Fury remaining.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Noxious Slipstream
passive.description: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.
passive.descriptionPt: Ao passar por Campeões próximos, Singed ganha Velocidade de Movimento.

spells.name: Poison Trail
spells.description: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.
spells.descriptionPt: Deixa um rastro de veneno atrás de Singed, causando dano aos inimigos que passam por este caminho.
spells.tooltip: Toggle: Singed lays a poisonous trail that deals {{ damagepersecond }} magic damage per second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Mega Adhesive
spells.description: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.
spells.descriptionPt: Joga um frasco de Mega Adesivo no chão, reduzindo a velocidade e prendendo os inimigos que pisam nele.
spells.tooltip: Singed hurls a cask of sticky liquid, Grounding and Slowing enemies in the area by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ wduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Fling
spells.description: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.
spells.descriptionPt: Causa dano ao inimigo alvo e o arremessa pelo ar para trás de Singed. Se o alvo que Singed arremessar aterrissar em seu Mega Adesivo, ele ficará enraizado.
spells.tooltip: Singed flings an enemy over his shoulder, dealing {{ basedamage }} plus {{ maxhpdamage }}% max Health magic damage . If Singed flings a target into his Mega Adhesive , they are Rooted for {{ rootduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Insanity Potion
spells.description: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.
spells.descriptionPt: Singed bebe uma mistura de compostos químicos potentes que concede a ele atributos de combate aumentados e faz com que o Rastro de Veneno aplique Feridas Dolorosas.
spells.tooltip: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him {{ statamount }} Ability Power , Armor , Magic Resist , Move Speed , Health Regen , and Mana Regen for {{ duration }} seconds. During this effect, Singed's Poison Trail also applies {{ grievousamount*100 }}% Grievous Wounds for {{ grievousduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Glory in Death
passive.description: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.
passive.descriptionPt: Após ser abatido, Sion será reanimado temporariamente, mas sua Vida decairá rapidamente. Seus ataques ficarão muito rápidos, curando e causando dano adicional com base na Vida máxima do alvo.

spells.name: Decimating Smash
spells.description: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.
spells.descriptionPt: Sion carrega um poderoso golpe em uma área à sua frente que causará dano a inimigos quando lançado. Caso carregue por tempo suficiente, também arremessará ao ar e atordoará os inimigos atingidos.
spells.tooltip: Begin Charging : Sion charges a heavy blow for up to 2 seconds. Release : Sion slams his axe down, briefly Slowing and dealing between {{ mindamagetotal }} and {{ maxdamagetotal }} physical damage based on charge time. If Sion charged for at least 1 second, enemies are Knocked Up and Stunned for between {{ basestuntime }} and 2.25 seconds based on charge time.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Soul Furnace
spells.description: Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby. When Sion kills enemies, he passively gains maximum Health.
spells.descriptionPt: Sion se protege e pode reativar após 3 segundos para causar Dano Mágico a inimigos próximos. Quando Sion abate inimigos, ele recebe Vida máxima passivamente.
spells.tooltip: Passive : Sion gains {{ hpperkill }} max Health when he kills a unit, or {{ hpperchampkill }} for champion takedowns, large minions and large monsters. Active : Sion gains {{ totalshield }} Shield for 6 seconds. After {{ detonaterecastcooldown }} seconds if the shield still holds, Sion can Recast to detonate the shield to deal {{ totaldamage }} plus {{ maxhpdamageratio }}% max Health magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Roar of the Slayer
spells.description: Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.
spells.descriptionPt: Sion dispara uma onda de choque de curto alcance que causa dano e reduz a velocidade e Armadura do primeiro inimigo atingido. Se ela atingir uma tropa ou monstro, o mesmo será arremessado para trás, causando dano e reduzindo a velocidade e Armadura de todos os inimigos que atravessar.
spells.tooltip: Sion fires a shockwave, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage , Slowing them by {{ slowamount }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds and removing {{ armorshred }}% Armor for {{ armorshredduration }} seconds. Non-champions hit are Knocked Back . Enemies hit by a Knocked Back unit take the same damage and effects.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
spells.description: Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time. He can steer his charge slightly with the mouse cursor location. When he collides with an enemy he deals damage and knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.
spells.descriptionPt: Sion avança em linha reta, acelerando ao longo do tempo. Ele pode guiar levemente sua investida com o cursor do mouse na posição. Ao colidir com um inimigo, ele causa dano e o arremessa ao ar com base na distância percorrida.
spells.tooltip: Sion charges Unstoppably in a direction for 8 seconds, turning towards the mouse cursor. Sion stops on colliding with an enemy champion or wall or on Recasting this Ability. At the end of the charge, Sion deals between {{ mindamagetotal }} and {{ maxdamagetotal }} physical damage based on distance travelled. Enemies close to Sion are Stunned for between {{ minstunduration }} and {{ maxstunduration }} seconds based on distance travelled. Enemies in a larger area are Slowed by {{ slowamount }}% for 3 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Fleet of Foot
passive.description: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.
passive.descriptionPt: Sivir ganha um pequeno impulso de Velocidade de Movimento quando ela ataca um campeão inimigo.

spells.name: Boomerang Blade
spells.description: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.
spells.descriptionPt: Sivir arremessa sua lâmina como um bumerangue, causando dano tanto na ida quanto na volta.
spells.tooltip: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing {{ totaldamage }} to all enemies it cuts through. Hitting non-champions reduces the damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of {{ falloffminimum*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ricochet
spells.description: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.
spells.descriptionPt: Os próximos ataques básicos de Sivir recebem Velocidade de Ataque adicional e ricocheteiam em alvos próximos, causando dano reduzido enquanto rebatem.
spells.tooltip: For the next {{ buffduration }} seconds, Sivir gains {{ ricochetattackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed and her auto attacks are empowered to bounce to additional surrounding enemies dealing {{ bouncedamage }} physical damage each bounce for up to {{ maxbounces }} bounces. These bounces critically strike if the attack generating them does.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spell Shield
spells.description: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.
spells.descriptionPt: Cria uma barreira mágica que bloqueia a habilidade de um único inimigo lançada em Sivir. Ela recebe Vida e uma explosão de Velocidade de Movimento se uma habilidade for bloqueada.
spells.tooltip: Sivir creates a magical barrier for {{ spellshieldduration }} seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy Ability. If an ability is blocked, Sivir restores {{ totalheal }} health and triggers Fleet of Foot.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: On The Hunt
spells.description: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.
spells.descriptionPt: Sivir conduz os aliados até a batalha, concedendo uma explosão de Velocidade de Movimento a eles por um curto período. Além disso, os ataques de Sivir reduzem o Tempo de Recarga das habilidades.
spells.tooltip: Sivir rallies her nearby allies, granting them {{ maxms*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ ultduration }} seconds. Sivir's attacks against champions while On The Hunt reduce the cooldown of her basic abilities by {{ attackcooldownrefund }} seconds. Takedowns on recently damaged enemies refreshes the duration of the hunt.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Threads of Vibration
passive.description: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.
passive.descriptionPt: Os Ataques do Skarner, Terra Arrasada, Sublevação e Empalar, aplicam Tremor. Com o máximo de acúmulos de Tremor, os inimigos sofrem Dano Mágico com base na Vida máxima ao longo da duração.

spells.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
spells.description: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.
spells.descriptionPt: Skarner arranca um pedregulho do chão que fortalece seus Ataques e pode ser arremessado como um projétil poderoso.
spells.tooltip: Skarner rips a boulder from the ground, empowering his next 3 Attacks with {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed and dealing {{ abilitydamage }} physical damage to surrounding enemies. His final Attack will deal an additional {{ maxhppercent*100 }}% max Health physical damage and Slow affected foes by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s. Recast: Skarner ends this Ability and throws his boulder, dealing {{ spell.skarnerq:abilitydamage }} + {{ spell.skarnerq:maxhppercent*100 }}% max Health physical damage , and additionally Slowing the first enemy hit — and any other surrounding enemies — by {{ spell.skarnerq:slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ spell.skarnerq:slowduration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Seismic Bastion
spells.description: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.
spells.descriptionPt: Skarner recebe um Escudo e cria um terremoto cuja onda de choque causa dano e Lentidão aos inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Skarner gains {{ initialshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }}s and triggers an earthquake that deals {{ damage }} magic damage and Slows nearby enemies by {{ sloweffect*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ixtal's Impact
spells.description: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.
spells.descriptionPt: Skarner avança e atravessa o terreno. Se colidir com um Campeão ou monstro grande, ele o empurrará contra uma parede próxima para causar dano e atordoá-lo.
spells.tooltip: Skarner charges forward, steering toward the chosen direction and ignoring terrain. If he runs into a champion or large monster, Skarner drags them along for the rest of his charge. Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals {{ pindamage }} physical damage to the enemy and Stuns them for {{ stunduration }}s. Skarner can Recast this Ability to end his charge early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Impale
spells.description: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.
spells.descriptionPt: As caudas de Skarner atacam e suprimem Campeões inimigos. Após serem suprimidas, as vítimas serão arrastadas por Skarner enquanto ele se movimenta.
spells.tooltip: Skarner's tails lash forward, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and Suppressing the first 3 champions he hits for {{ duration }}s. Those hit are dragged along by Skarner for the duration of this Ability. If Skarner hits at least one champion he gains {{ speedboostamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ speedboostduration }} seconds. If Shattered Earth is active, Skarner will cast Upheaval first.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Dragon Practice
passive.description: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.
passive.descriptionPt: Acertar Campeões com habilidades e abater inimigos com Super-Hálito Flamejante concede um acúmulo de Treinamento Dracônico. Os acúmulos aumentam o dano das habilidades básicas de Smolder.

spells.name: Super Scorcher Breath
spells.description: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.
spells.descriptionPt: Smolder cospe fogo em um inimigo. Conforme obtém mais acúmulos, a Habilidade se torna ainda mais poderosa.
spells.tooltip: Smolder belches flame, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage + {{ spell.smolderp:passive_qdamageincrease }} magic damage . If the target dies, Smolder refunds {{ manarestore }} Mana , once per cast. Based on stacks of Dragon Practice , this Ability evolves to gain the following effects: {{ stacktier1 }} Stacks : Damages all enemies surrounding the target. {{ stacktier2 }} Stacks : Sends {{ tier2_numberofblowback }} explosions beyond the target that deal {{ tier2_blowbackpercentagedamage }}% of this Ability's damage. {{ stacktier3 }} Stacks : Burns the target, dealing {{ tier3_burn }} max Health true damage over {{ tier3_dotlength }} seconds. Enemy champions that drop below {{ tier3_executethreshold }} total health while burning are killed instantly.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Achooo!
spells.description: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.
spells.descriptionPt: Smolder dá um adorável espirro flamejante que explode ao atingir Campeões inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze, dealing {{ initialdamage }} physical damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Hitting champions causes an explosion, dealing {{ explosiondamage }} physical + {{ spell.smolderp:passive_wdamageincrease }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
spells.description: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.
spells.descriptionPt: Smolder voa, ignorando os terrenos e bombardeando o inimigo com a Vida mais baixa.
spells.tooltip: Smolder takes flight, gaining {{ movespeed*100 }}% Move Speed and ignoring terrain for {{ duration }} seconds. While flying, Smolder bombards the lowest Health enemy {{ totalnumberofattacks }} (rounded down) times for {{ damageperhit }} physical damage + {{ spell.smolderp:ebonusdamage }} magic damage per hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: MMOOOMMMM!
spells.description: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.
spells.descriptionPt: Smolder chama sua mãe para cuspir fogo das alturas, causando dano adicional e Lentidão aos inimigos no centro das chamas.
spells.tooltip: Smolder's mom breathes fire from above, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage . Enemies in the center take {{ tooltiponly_totalsweetspotdamage }} physical damage instead and are Slowed by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Smolder's mom heals her son for {{ momhealcalc }} Health if she hits him.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Power Chord
passive.description: Accelerando : Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead. Power Chord : Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.
passive.descriptionPt: Accelerando : Sona recebe Aceleração permanentemente para as Habilidades básicas (exceto a ultimate), caso use-as corretamente, até um limite. Depois disso, o uso bem-sucedido reduz o Tempo de Recarga restante da ultimate. Power Chord : depois de algumas Habilidades conjuradas, o próximo Ataque de Sona causará Dano Mágico adicional e um efeito extra com base na última Habilidade básica ativada por ela.

spells.name: Hymn of Valor
spells.description: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Sona toca o Hino do Valor, conjurando rajadas de som, causando Dano Mágico a dois inimigos próximos, priorizando Campeões e monstros. Sona recebe uma aura temporária que concede dano adicional no próximo ataque de aliados próximos contra inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Sona deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the nearest two enemies, prioritizing champions. She then begins a new Melody . Gain a stack of Accelerando for every champion you damage with this. Melody: Sona gains an aura for {{ auraduration }} seconds, granting allied champions an additional {{ totalonhitdamage }} magic damage %i:OnHit% on their next Attack within {{ onhitduration }} seconds. Power Chord - Staccato: Power Chord bonus damage ( {{ totalstaccatodamage }} total magic damage ).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Aria of Perseverance
spells.description: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.
spells.descriptionPt: Sona toca a Ária da Perseverança, conjurando melodias protetoras, curando a si mesma e a um aliado ferido próximo. Sona recebe uma aura temporária que concede um escudo momentâneo a aliados marcados pela área.
spells.tooltip: Active: Sona restores {{ totalheal }} Health to herself and a nearby allied champion, prioritizing the most wounded. She then begins a new Melody . Melody: Sona gains an aura for {{ auraduration }} seconds, granting allied champions {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. Gain a stack of Accelerando whenever you heal another injured ally and every time you protect another ally from at least {{ accelerandoshieldbreakpoint }} damage with this shield. Power Chord - Diminuendo: Power Chord also reduces physical and magic damage dealt by the target by {{ totaldiminuendoweakenpercent }} for {{ diminuendoduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Song of Celerity
spells.description: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.
spells.descriptionPt: Sona toca a Canção da Celeridade, concedendo Velocidade de Movimento adicional a aliados próximos. Sona recebe uma aura temporária que concede Velocidade de Movimento adicional a Campeões aliados marcados pela área.
spells.tooltip: Active: She begins a new Melody and grants herself {{ totalselfmovementspeed }} Move Speed for {{ selfmovementspeeddurationmin }} seconds, extended to up to {{ selfmovementspeeddurationmax }} seconds if she doesn't take damage. Melody: Sona gains an aura for {{ auraduration }} seconds that grants allied champions {{ totalallymovementspeed }} Move Speed for {{ allymovementspeedduration }} seconds. Power Chord - Tempo: Power Chord also Slows the target by {{ totaltempomovespeedslow }} for {{ tempoduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Crescendo
spells.description: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.
spells.descriptionPt: Sona toca o seu melhor acorde, causando Dano Mágico, atordoando Campeões inimigos e forçando-os a dançar.
spells.tooltip: Sona strikes an irresistible chord, Stunning enemy for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Salvation
passive.description: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.
passive.descriptionPt: Soraka corre mais rapidamente em direção a aliados com pouca Vida.

spells.name: Starcall
spells.description: A star falls from the sky at the target location dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If an enemy champion is hit by Starcall, Soraka recovers Health.
spells.descriptionPt: Uma estrela cai do céu no local-alvo, causando Dano Mágico e reduzindo a velocidade de inimigos. Se um Campeão inimigo for atingido por Chamado Estelar, Soraka regenera Vida.
spells.tooltip: Soraka calls down a star, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ movespeedslow*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Hitting an enemy champion grants Soraka Rejuvenation , which restores {{ totalhot }} Health over {{ hotduration }} seconds and grants {{ movespeedhaste*100 }}% Move Speed decaying over the same duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Astral Infusion
spells.description: Soraka sacrifices a portion of her own health to heal another friendly champion.
spells.descriptionPt: Soraka sacrifica parte de sua própria Vida para curar outro Campeão aliado.
spells.tooltip: Soraka restores {{ totalheal }} Health to another allied champion. If Soraka is affected by Rejuvenation , the Health cost will be reduced by {{ percenthealthcostrefund*100 }}%, and the target will gain Rejuvenation for {{ spell.sorakaq:hotduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Equinox
spells.description: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.
spells.descriptionPt: Cria uma área em um local, silenciando todos os inimigos dentro dela. Quando a área expira, os que ainda estiverem dentro são enraizados.
spells.tooltip: Soraka creates a starfield that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to champions. The field lingers for {{ rootdelay }} seconds, Silencing enemies inside. When the zone disappears, champions inside the zone are Rooted for {{ rootduration }} second(s) and take {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Wish
spells.description: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.
spells.descriptionPt: Soraka enche seus aliados de esperança, instantaneamente restaurando Vida para si mesma e todos os Campeões aliados.
spells.tooltip: Soraka calls upon divine powers, restoring {{ healingcalc }} Health to all allied champions, regardless of distance. Healing is increased to {{ ampedhealing }} on targets below 40% Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Ravenous Flock
passive.description: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.
passive.descriptionPt: Os corvos de Swain coletam Fragmentos de Alma que o curam e aumentam permanentemente a Vida máxima dele.

spells.name: Death's Hand
spells.description: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.
spells.descriptionPt: Swain dispara vários raios de poder sombrio que perfuram os inimigos. Inimigos atingidos sofrem mais dano para cada raio que os atingir.
spells.tooltip: Swain unleashes 5 eldritch bolts, dealing {{ initialdamage }} magic damage plus {{ extraboltdamage }} magic damage per bolt past the first (max {{ maxdamage }} magic damage ).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Vision of Empire
spells.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.
spells.descriptionPt: Swain abre um olho demoníaco que causa dano e reduz a velocidade dos inimigos. Campeões atingidos são revelados e concedem um Fragmento de Alma a Swain.
spells.tooltip: Swain opens a demon eye, revealing a location for 1.5 seconds, then deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slows by {{ slow*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Champions hit grant Swain a Soul Fragment and are revealed for {{ revealduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Nevermove
spells.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.
spells.descriptionPt: Swain lança uma onda de poder demoníaco à frente. Em seguida, a onda retorna para Swain e enraíza os inimigos que atingir. Swain pode escolher puxar todos os Campeões inimigos enraizados para perto. Esta Habilidade tem Tempo de Recarga reduzido durante Ascensão Demoníaca.
spells.tooltip: Swain launches a wave of demonic power that returns, detonating on the first enemy hit to deal {{ secondarydamage }} magic damage and Root enemies in the area for {{ rootduration }} seconds. Rooting a champion allows Swain to reactivate this ability to pull all champions Rooted by Nevermove toward him, gaining a Soul Fragment for each.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Demonic Ascension
spells.description: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.
spells.descriptionPt: Swain se transforma em demônio e drena Vida de Campeões, tropas e monstros neutros próximos. Swain pode conjurar Chama Demoníaca para dizimar e causar Lentidão a inimigos próximos com uma explosão de fogo espiritual. Essa forma é indefinida enquanto Swain drenar Campeões inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Swain frees the demon, which deals {{ damagecalc }} magic damage and drains {{ healingcalc }} Health per second from nearby enemies. His Demonic Energy depletes over time but can be recharged indefinitely by draining enemy Champions and is fully restored on Champion takedowns. After {{ demonflarecastdelay }} seconds and every {{ demonflarecooldowntooltip }} seconds thereafter, Swain can cast Demonflare while transformed, which deals {{ demonflaredamagetotal }} magic damage and Slows enemies by {{ demonflareslowamount*100 }}%, decaying over {{ demonflareslowduration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Petricite Burst
passive.description: After casting a spell, Sylas stores a charge of Petricite Burst. Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit. While Sylas has a charge of Petricite Burst, he gains attack speed.
passive.descriptionPt: Após conjurar uma habilidade, Sylas armazena uma carga de Explosão de Petricita. Seus ataques básicos gastam uma carga e agitam as correntes energizadas ao redor dele, causando Dano Mágico adicional a inimigos atingidos. Enquanto Sylas tiver pelo menos uma carga de Explosão de Petricita, ele recebe Velocidade de Ataque.

spells.name: Chain Lash
spells.description: Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies. After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage.
spells.descriptionPt: Sylas chicoteia com suas correntes, que se intersectam no local-alvo, causando dano e reduzindo a velocidade dos inimigos. Após um intervalo, há uma explosão de energia mágica no ponto da intersecção, causando dano.
spells.tooltip: Sylas lashes his chains out, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowamountcalc }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds. The place where the chains intersect explodes, dealing a further {{ explosiondamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Kingslayer
spells.description: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.
spells.descriptionPt: Sylas avança em um inimigo com uma força mágica, causando dano e curando-se contra Campeões inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing {{ mindamage }} magic damage . Against champions, Sylas restores between {{ minhealing }} and {{ maxhealing }} Health based on his missing Health (max healing at or below {{ maxexecutethreshold*100 }}% Health).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Abscond / Abduct
spells.description: Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.
spells.descriptionPt: Sylas avança por uma curta distância, podendo reconjurar a habilidade para arremessar suas correntes e se arrastar na direção do inimigo atingido.
spells.tooltip: Sylas quickly dashes, and prepares a Recast for 3.5 seconds. Recast: Sylas throws his chains, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage , and Knocking Up for {{ knockupduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hijack
spells.description: Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.
spells.descriptionPt: Sylas rouba a habilidade ultimate do inimigo e pode conjurá-la sem custo.
spells.tooltip: Sylas hijacks an enemy champion, allowing him to cast a copy of their ultimate Ability, based on his Ultimate level and using his stats. Hijacking an enemy places a Cooldown on them for {{ pertargetcooldown }}% (modified by Sylas' Ability Haste) of the enemy's ultimate's Cooldown, with a minimum of {{ minimumenemycooldown }} seconds, during which time Sylas cannot hijack them again.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Transcendent
passive.description: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities. Dark Sphere : Syndra can hold an additional charge Force of Will : Bonus true damage. Scatter the Weak : Increased width and slows all targets Unleashed Power : Executes low health targets
passive.descriptionPt: Syndra coleta Farpas de Ira ao subir de nível ou causar dano a inimigos, aprimorando as próprias habilidades. Esfera Negra : Syndra pode segurar uma carga adicional. Força de Vontade : Dano Verdadeiro adicional. Dispersar os Fracos : largura aumentada e causa Lentidão a todos os alvos. Poder Irrestrito : executa alvos com a Vida baixa.

spells.name: Dark Sphere
spells.description: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.
spells.descriptionPt: Syndra conjura uma Esfera Negra, causando Dano Mágico. A esfera permanece em seu lugar e pode ser manipulada por seus outros poderes.
spells.tooltip: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere , dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . The Dark Sphere remains for {{ sphereduration }} seconds and can be manipulated by Syndra's other Abilities. {{ spell.syndrapassive:q1upgradethreshold }} Splinters of Wrath : Syndra can store {{ upgrade1maxammo }} charges of Dark Sphere .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Force of Will
spells.description: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Syndra apanha e arremessa uma Esfera Negra ou tropa inimiga, causando Dano Mágico e reduzindo a Velocidade de Movimento de inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Syndra grabs a Dark Sphere , enemy minion, or non-epic monster. She drags it with her and can Recast for up to 5 seconds. Recast : Syndra hurls the object, dealing {{ throwdamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ totalslowamount }}% for {{ f2 }} seconds. {{ spell.syndrapassive:wupgradethreshold }} Splinters of Wrath : This Ability deals an additional {{ tooltiponlypassivebonuspercent }} true damage . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Scatter the Weak
spells.description: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.
spells.descriptionPt: Syndra afasta inimigos e Esferas Negras, causando Dano Mágico. Inimigos atingidos pelas Esferas Negras ficam atordoados.
spells.tooltip: Syndra projects a wave of force, Knocking Back enemies and Dark Spheres and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Dark Spheres that are pushed Stun enemies for {{ stunduration }} seconds and deal {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . {{ spell.syndrapassive:eupgradethreshold }} Splinters of Wrath : This Ability's width is increased and Slows enemies by {{ upgradedslowamount*100 }}% for {{ upgradedslowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Unleashed Power
spells.description: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.
spells.descriptionPt: Syndra bombardeia um Campeão inimigo com todas as suas Esferas Negras.
spells.tooltip: Passive : Dark Sphere gains an additional {{ qhasteperrank }} Ability Haste for each rank of Unleashed Power . Syndra draws on her full cataclysmic power, launching the 3 Dark Spheres orbiting her plus up to 4 more nearby at an enemy champion. Each Dark Sphere deals {{ damagecalc }} magic damage (max {{ maxdamagecalc }} magic damage ). {{ spell.syndrapassive:rupgradethreshold }} Splinters of Wrath : This Ability executes enemies below {{ upgradeexecutethreshold*100 }}% Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: An Acquired Taste
passive.description: Tahm Kench puts the heft of his immense body behind his attacks, gaining extra damage based on his total health. Damaging enemy champions builds stacks of An Acquired Taste . At three stacks, he can use Devour on an enemy champion.
passive.descriptionPt: Tahm Kench usa o próprio corpo para impulsionar os Ataques, causando dano adicional com base na Vida total dele. Causar dano a Campeões inimigos aumenta os acúmulos de Um Gosto Adquirido . Com três acúmulos, ele pode usar Devorar em um Campeão inimigo.

spells.name: Tongue Lash
spells.description: Tahm Kench lashes out with his tongue, damaging and slowing the first unit hit and healing himself if he strikes an enemy champion. Applies a stack of An Acquired Taste to enemy champions. If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste , they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.
spells.descriptionPt: Tahm Kench ataca com a língua, causando dano e Lentidão à primeira unidade atingida, além de se curar se a unidade for um Campeão inimigo. Aplica um acúmulo de Um Gosto Adquirido a Campeões inimigos. Se o Campeão já tiver 3 acúmulos de Um Gosto Adquirido , ele será Atordoado e os acúmulos serão consumidos.
spells.tooltip: Deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slows them by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. On champion hit, heals Tahm for {{ baseheal }} +{{ percenthealthhealing*100 }}% of his missing Health and applies a stack of An Acquired Taste dealing {{ spell.tahmkenchpassive:totaldamage }} extra magic damage . If that champion already had 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste , they will also be Stunned for {{ stunduration }} seconds, consuming the stacks. Activate Devour while your tongue is in midair to devour enemy champions who already have 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste from a distance when you hit them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Abyssal Dive
spells.description: Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area.
spells.descriptionPt: Mergulha e reaparece no local-alvo, causando dano e Arremessando ao ar todos os inimigos em uma área.
spells.tooltip: Dive down and then re-appear at target location, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Knock Up all enemies in an area for {{ knockupduration }} second. Hitting at least one enemy champion refunds {{ champrefund*100 }}% of the Cooldown and Mana cost. Devoured allies can be taken along for the ride (but can always hop out early).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Thick Skin
spells.description: Passive: Tahm Kench stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat. Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield.
spells.descriptionPt: Passivo: Tahm Kench armazena uma porcentagem do dano sofrido e se cura com base nela quando fora de combate. Ativo: converte todo o dano armazenado em um Escudo temporário.
spells.tooltip: Passive: {{ greyhealthratio*100 }}% of damage Tahm Kench takes is stored by his Thick Skin , increased to {{ greyhealthratioenhanced*100 }}% if there are at least {{ enhancedthreshold }} nearby enemy champions. If Kench has not taken damage within {{ ooctimer }} seconds, Thick Skin will rapidly be consumed to heal Tahm for {{ greyhealthhealingratio }} of its value. Active: Convert all your stored Thick Skin into a Shield , lasting {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Devour
spells.description: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally.
spells.descriptionPt: Tahm Kench devora um Campeão por alguns segundos, causando Dano Mágico se for um inimigo ou concedendo Escudo se for um aliado.
spells.tooltip: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds. He can Recast to spit them out. Enemy Champions: Require 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste . Are devoured for up to {{ enemyduration }} seconds and take {{ basedamage }} (+{{ percenthpdamage }} of their Max Health) magic damage . Tahm Kench is Slowed by {{ slowamount*100 }}% and Grounded during this effect. Ally Champions: Are devoured for up to {{ allyduration }} seconds and are granted {{ totalshield }} Shield which decays gradually after being spit out. Allies can also choose to exit early. Tahm Kench is Grounded during this effect, but can cast Abyssal Dive and gains {{ allyspeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ allyduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Rock Surfing
passive.description: Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.
passive.descriptionPt: Taliyah recebe Velocidade de Movimento próxima a paredes.

spells.name: Threaded Volley
spells.description: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, moving freely as she casts. This creates Worked Ground below her. If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Taliyah arremessa uma rajada de pedras na direção-alvo, movimentando-se livremente durante a conjuração. Isso cria um Terreno Manipulado sob ela. Se Taliyah conjurar Voleio Entrelaçado em Terreno Manipulado, ela consome o terreno para arremessar um pedregulho fortalecido que causa Lentidão a inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Taliyah hurls 5 rocks, each dealing {{ rockdamage }} magic damage in an area around the first enemy hit while creating Worked Ground at that area. Subsequent hits against the same enemy deal {{ extramissilereduceddamagepercent }}% less damage. Casts on worked ground cost {{ bigrockmanacost }} Mana and have {{ workedgroundcdr*100 }}% less Cooldown, consume the Worked Ground, and hurl a boulder that Slows enemies it hits by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds, dealing {{ bigrockdamage }} magic damage to the primary target. Monsters hit by the boulder are Stunned for {{ monsterstunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Seismic Shove
spells.description: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.
spells.descriptionPt: Taliyah faz com que uma área do terreno irrompa e arremesse inimigos na direção de sua escolha.
spells.tooltip: Taliyah quakes the earth, Knocking enemies in an area in the chosen direction.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Unraveled Earth
spells.description: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.
spells.descriptionPt: Taliyah cria um campo minado de Lentidão. Caso inimigos avancem ou sejam arremessados através dele, as minas explodem, atordoando-os.
spells.tooltip: Taliyah scatters loose stones in an area, Slowing enemies hit by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% and dealing {{ scatterdamage }} magic damage . The stones detonate when enemies dash or are Knocked through them, Stunning for the remaining movement duration + {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing {{ detonationdamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Weaver's Wall
spells.description: Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it.
spells.descriptionPt: Taliyah cria uma parede comprida e desliza sobre ela.
spells.tooltip: Taliyah creates a massive earthen wall for {{ wallduration }} seconds. If she immediately Recasts , she will ride along the wall as it unravels. Moving or being immobilized will end the ride. This ability cannot be cast if Taliyah has taken damage from Champions or structures within the last {{ damagelockouttime }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Blade's End
passive.description: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.
passive.descriptionPt: As habilidades de Talon causam Ferimentos em Campeões e monstros grandes, acumulando até 3 vezes. Quando Talon ataca um Campeão com 3 acúmulos de Ferimento, o alvo sofre intenso dano de sangramento ao longo do tempo.

spells.name: Noxian Diplomacy
spells.description: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.
spells.descriptionPt: Talon apunhala a unidade alvo. Caso eles estejam próximos o suficiente para um ataque corpo a corpo, o ataque causa dano crítico. Caso estejam fora do alcance corpo a corpo, Talon saltará no alvo e o apunhalará. Talon recupera um pouco da vida e do Tempo de Recarga caso sua habilidade abata o alvo.
spells.tooltip: Talon leaps to a target and deals {{ leapdamage }} physical damage . If used in melee range, this Ability instead critically strikes for {{ criticaldamage }} physical damage . If this Ability kills the target, Talon restores {{ totalhealing }} Health and refunds {{ cooldownrefund*100 }}% of its Cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Rake
spells.description: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.
spells.descriptionPt: Talon envia um voleio de adagas que retorna a ele, causando Dano Físico a cada vez que passar por um inimigo. As lâminas que retornarem causam dano adicional e reduzem a velocidade da unidade.
spells.tooltip: Talon tosses a volley of blades, dealing {{ totalinitialdamage }} physical damage . The blades then return to him, dealing {{ totalreturndamage }} physical damage and Slowing by {{ movespeedslow*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Assassin's Path
spells.description: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.
spells.descriptionPt: Talon salta sobre quaisquer terrenos ou estruturas, até uma distância máxima. Esta habilidade possui um Tempo de Recarga baixo, mas deixa o terreno inutilizável por um longo período de tempo.
spells.tooltip: Talon vaults over the nearest terrain or structure. Talon cannot dash over the same terrain more than once every {{ wallcd }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Shadow Assault
spells.description: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.
spells.descriptionPt: Talon dispara um anel de lâminas e fica Invisível ao mesmo tempo em que recebe Velocidade de Movimento adicional.
