Quando Talon surge da Invisibilidade, as lâminas convergem em sua direção. A cada vez que a lâmina se move, Ataque das Sombras causa Dano Físico aos inimigos atingidos por ao menos uma lâmina.
spells.tooltip: Talon disperses a ring of blades that deal {{ damage }} physical damage , gains {{ movespeed*100 }}% Move Speed , and becomes Invisible for {{ duration }} seconds. When the Invisibility ends, the blades return to Talon, dealing {{ damage }} physical damage again. If Talon cancels the Invisibility with an Attack or with Noxian Diplomacy , the blades return to the target instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Bravado
passive.description: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.
passive.descriptionPt: Conjurações fortalecem os próximos 2 ataques básicos de Taric, causando Dano Mágico adicional, reduzindo Tempos de Recarga e atacando em rápida sucessão.

spells.name: Starlight's Touch
spells.description: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.
spells.descriptionPt: Cura Campeões aliados próximos com base nas cargas armazenadas. Ataques fortalecidos por Bravata concedem uma carga de Fulgor Estelar.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Gain a stack (max {{ maxcharges }}) every {{ stackcooldown }} seconds and when hitting a Bravado Attack. Active: Consume all stacks to restore {{ healingperstack }} Health per stack to nearby ally champions ( {{ maxstackhealing }} at {{ maxcharges }} stacks).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Bastion
spells.description: Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion. Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.
spells.descriptionPt: Aumenta passivamente a Armadura de Taric e de qualquer Campeão aliado com Bastião. Protege ativamente um aliado e lhe concede Bastião por todo o tempo que permanecer próximo a Taric. As habilidades de Taric também são conjuradas a partir do aliado com Bastião.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Taric gains {{ bonusarmor }} Armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by this Ability. As long as they are near each other, the ally gains {{ bonusarmor }} Armor and Taric casts all his Abilities from both himself and his linked ally. Active: Taric binds to an ally champion, granting a {{ shieldhpratio }}% max Health Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Dazzle
spells.description: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Taric prepara um feixe de luz estelar que, após um breve intervalo, causa Dano Mágico e atordoa inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Taric projects a beam of starlight, bursting after {{ chargeduration }} second to deal {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Stun enemies for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Cosmic Radiance
spells.description: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.
spells.descriptionPt: Faz pulsar energia cósmica em Campeões aliados próximos após um intervalo, tornando-os invulneráveis por um curto período.
spells.tooltip: Taric calls down protection from the heavens. After {{ initialdelay }} seconds, nearby ally champions become invulnerable for {{ invulnduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Guerrilla Warfare
passive.description: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.
passive.descriptionPt: Se Teemo permanece imóvel e não faz nada por um curto período, fica Invisível por tempo indefinido. Caso esteja em um arbusto, Teemo pode manter sua Invisibilidade enquanto se move. Ao sair da Invisibilidade, Teemo ativa Elemento-Surpresa, aumentando a própria Velocidade de Ataque por alguns segundos.

spells.name: Blinding Dart
spells.description: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.
spells.descriptionPt: Obscurece a visão de um inimigo com um poderoso veneno, causando dano e cegueira ao alvo pela duração do efeito.
spells.tooltip: Teemo fires a dart, Blinding the target for {{ blindduration }} seconds and dealing {{ calculateddamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Move Quick
spells.description: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.
spells.descriptionPt: Teemo corre por aí, aumentando passivamente sua Velocidade de Movimento até ser atingido por um Campeão ou torre inimiga. Ele pode sair em disparada para receber Velocidade de Movimento adicional (que não é interrompida por ataques) por um breve período.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Teemo gains {{ passivemovespeedbonus*100 }}% Move Speed while he hasn't been damaged by a champion or turret in the last {{ passivecooldownondamagetaken }} seconds. Active: Teemo sprints, gaining {{ activemovespeedbonus*100 }}% Move Speed that is not lost when struck for {{ activemovespeedbuffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Toxic Shot
spells.description: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit , dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.
spells.descriptionPt: Cada um dos ataques de Teemo envenenará o alvo %i:OnHit% ao contato , causando dano no impacto e a cada segundo seguinte por 4s.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Teemo's Attacks apply poison %i:OnHit% On-Hit , dealing an additional {{ impactcalculateddamage }} magic damage plus {{ totaldotdamage }} magic damage over {{ poisonduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Noxious Trap
spells.description: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.
spells.descriptionPt: Teemo arremessa uma armadilha venenosa explosiva usando um dos cogumelos que guardou na mochila. Se um inimigo pisa na armadilha, ela solta uma nuvem venenosa que causa Lentidão e dano ao longo do tempo. Se Teemo arremessar um cogumelo em cima de outro, ele saltará, recebendo alcance adicional.
spells.tooltip: Teemo tosses a mushroom trap that detonates when stepped on. The traps Slow by {{ slowamount }}% and deal {{ totaldamage }} magic damage over {{ debuffduration }} seconds. Enemies are revealed for the same duration. Traps last {{ mushroomduration }} minutes and are stealthed. A mushroom tossed onto another mushroom bounces before landing at its position. This Ability has {{ maxammo }} charges ({{ ammorechargetime }} second refresh). {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Damnation
passive.description: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.
passive.descriptionPt: Thresh pode colher a alma de inimigos que morrerem perto dele, recebendo Armadura e Poder de Habilidade permanentemente.

spells.name: Death Sentence
spells.description: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.
spells.descriptionPt: Thresh prende um inimigo em suas correntes e puxa em sua direção. Ativar essa habilidade uma segunda vez puxa Thresh em direção ao inimigo.
spells.tooltip: Thresh throws out his scythe, Stunning the first unit hit and Pulling them towards Thresh for {{ tauntlength }} seconds. The scythe does {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and also grants True Sight for the duration. Thresh can Recast this Ability to pull himself to the enemy. If this Ability hits, its Cooldown is reduced by {{ hitbonuscooldown }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Dark Passage
spells.description: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.
spells.descriptionPt: Thresh arremessa uma lanterna que protege Campeões aliados próximos contra danos. Aliados podem clicar na lanterna para avançar na direção de Thresh.
spells.tooltip: Thresh throws his lantern, allowing an ally to click on it to dash to Thresh. The lantern also grants {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds to Thresh and the first ally champion to come in contact with it.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Flay
spells.description: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.
spells.descriptionPt: Os ataques de Thresh são fortalecidos, causando mais dano quanto mais tempo ele esperar entre ataques. Ao ativar, Thresh arrasta sua corrente e empurra todos os inimigos atingidos na direção do golpe.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Thresh's Attacks deal additional damage based on how long since he last Attacked. They deal between {{ pattackdamagemin }} and {{ pattackdamagemax }} magic damage . Active: Thresh whips his chains, Pulling or Pushing enemies in the direction of the swing. Enemies hit are also Slowed by {{ activeslowpercentage }}% for {{ slowduration }} second and take {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: The Box
spells.description: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.
spells.descriptionPt: Uma prisão de paredes que causam dano e Lentidão se quebradas.
spells.tooltip: Thresh creates a prison of spectral walls, Slowing champions by {{ slowamount }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Walls break after one collision, and after one is broken, the rest deal no damage and Slow for half duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Draw a Bead
passive.description: Increases Tristana's Attack Range as she levels.
passive.descriptionPt: Aumenta o Alcance de Ataque de Tristana conforme ela sobe de nível.

spells.name: Rapid Fire
spells.description: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time.
spells.descriptionPt: Tristana dispara rapidamente com seu canhão, aumentando sua Velocidade de Ataque por um curto período de tempo.
spells.tooltip: Tristana goes full-auto, gaining {{ attackspeedmod*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ buffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Rocket Jump
spells.description: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.
spells.descriptionPt: Tristana dispara no chão para lançar-se ao local-alvo, causando dano e reduzindo a Velocidade de Movimento das unidades ao seu redor por um breve momento ao aterrissar.
spells.tooltip: Tristana launches herself, dealing {{ landingdamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowmod*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds upon landing. Champion takedowns and max stack Explosive Charge detonations on champions refresh this Ability's Cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Explosive Charge
spells.description: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Can be activated to place a bomb on a target enemy that explodes after a short duration dealing damage to surrounding units.
spells.descriptionPt: Quando Tristana abate uma unidade, seus projéteis explodem com estilhaços, causando dano a inimigos próximos. Isso pode ser ativado para posicionar uma bomba em um alvo inimigo, que explodirá após uma curta duração, causando dano a unidades ao seu redor.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Tristana's Attacks that kill enemies deal {{ passivedamage }} magic damage to surrounding enemies. Active: Tristana attaches a bomb to an enemy or turret that deals {{ activedamage }} physical damage to surrounding enemies after {{ activeduration }} seconds. The damage is increased by {{ activeperstackamp*100 }}% each time Tristana hits an Attack or Ability (max 4 stacks). At {{ activemaxstacks }} stacks, the bomb explodes immediately (max {{ activemaxdamage }} physical damage ).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Buster Shot
spells.description: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back. If the target is carrying the Explosive Charge bomb, the bomb detonation radius is doubled.
spells.descriptionPt: Tristana carrega uma gigantesca bala de canhão em sua arma e a dispara em uma unidade inimiga. Isso causa Dano Mágico e empurra o alvo para trás. Se o alvo estiver carregando uma bomba da Carga Explosiva, o raio de explosão da bomba é dobrado.
spells.tooltip: Tristana fires a massive cannonball, dealing {{ damagecalc }} magic damage to the target, Knocking Back and Stunning them and surrounding enemies for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: King's Tribute
passive.description: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.
passive.descriptionPt: Quando uma unidade inimiga morre perto de Trundle, ele é curado em um percentual da Vida máxima desta unidade.

spells.name: Chomp
spells.description: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.
spells.descriptionPt: Trundle morde seu oponente, causando dano, brevemente reduzindo sua Velocidade de Movimento e drenando parte de seu Dano de Ataque.
spells.tooltip: Trundle's next Attack deals {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and briefly Slows by {{ slowamount*100 }}%, then Trundle gains {{ bonusad }} Attack Damage for {{ sapdebuffduration }} seconds and the enemy loses {{ sappedad*-1 }} Attack Damage for the same duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Frozen Domain
spells.description: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.
spells.descriptionPt: Trundle transforma o local-alvo em seu domínio, recebendo Velocidade de Ataque, Velocidade de Movimento e cura aprimorada de todas as fontes enquanto estiver sobre a região.
spells.tooltip: Trundle freezes an area for {{ duration }} seconds. While inside he gains {{ msbonus*100 }}% Move Speed , {{ asbonus*100 }}% Attack Speed , and {{ healingbonus*100 }}% increased healing.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Pillar of Ice
spells.description: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.
spells.descriptionPt: Trundle cria um pilar de gelo no local-alvo, tornando-o um terreno intransponível e causando Lentidão a todas as unidades inimigas próximas.
spells.tooltip: Trundle creates an icy pillar for {{ pillarduration }} seconds, briefly Knocking Back enemies directly over it and Slowing nearby enemies by {{ slowamount }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Subjugate
spells.description: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.
spells.descriptionPt: Trundle imediatamente rouba um percentual da Vida, Armadura e Resistência Mágica de seu alvo. Ao longo dos próximos 4 segundos, a quantia de Vida, Armadura e Resistência Mágica roubada é dobrada.
spells.tooltip: Trundle drains the lifeforce of an enemy champion, dealing {{ totalpercenthpdamage }} max Health magic damage and stealing {{ armormrshred*100 }}% Armor and Magic Resist over {{ actualdurationofdrainbuff }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Battle Fury
passive.description: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.
passive.descriptionPt: Tryndamere recebe Fúria para cada ataque, acerto crítico e golpe fatal que realiza. A Fúria passivamente aumenta a sua Chance de Acerto Crítico e pode ser consumida com a habilidade Sanguinário.

spells.name: Bloodlust
spells.description: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.
spells.descriptionPt: Tryndamere prospera com o calor do combate, aumentando seu próprio Dano de Ataque conforme for ficando mais e mais ferido. Ele pode conjurar Sanguinário para consumir sua Fúria e curar a si mesmo.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Tryndamere thirsts for blood, gaining up to {{ maximumbonusad }} Attack Damage based on his missing Health. Active: Tryndamere consumes his Fury , restoring {{ baseheal }} plus {{ healperfury }} Health per Fury (max: {{ maximumheal }}) . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Mocking Shout
spells.description: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.
spells.descriptionPt: Tryndamere solta um grito insultante, diminuindo o Dano de Ataque dos Campeões próximos. Inimigos que estiverem de costas para Tryndamere também têm sua Velocidade de Movimento reduzida.
spells.tooltip: Tryndamere hurls insults, reducing champions' Attack Damage by {{ adreduction*-1 }} for {{ reductionduration }} seconds and Slowing by {{ slowpotency*-100 }}% while cowering from him for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spinning Slash
spells.description: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.
spells.descriptionPt: Tryndamere avança em direção a uma unidade-alvo, causando dano aos inimigos em seu trajeto.
spells.tooltip: Tryndamere spins through his enemies, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and generating {{ nonchampfurygain }} Fury per enemy hit, increased to {{ champfurygain }} Fury against enemy champions. This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by {{ nonchampcdrefund }} seconds when Tryndamere critically strikes, and reduced by {{ champcdrefund }} seconds when critically striking a champion.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Undying Rage
spells.description: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.
spells.descriptionPt: O desejo de Tryndamere pela batalha se torna tão forte que ele fica incapaz de morrer, não importa o quão ferido ele esteja.
spells.tooltip: Tryndamere becomes completely immune to death for {{ tryndrduration }} seconds, refusing to be reduced below {{ tryndrminhealth }} Health, and instantly gains {{ tryndrfurygain }} Fury .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Loaded Dice
passive.description: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.
passive.descriptionPt: Ao abater uma unidade, Twisted Fate rola seu dado da ''sorte'' e recebe de 1 a 6 de ouro adicional.

spells.name: Wild Cards
spells.description: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.
spells.descriptionPt: Twisted Fate arremessa três cartas, causando dano a cada inimigo que elas atravessam.
spells.tooltip: Twisted Fate throws three cards that deal {{ totaldamage }} magic damage each.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Pick a Card
spells.description: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.
spells.descriptionPt: Twisted Fate escolhe uma carta mágica de seu baralho e a usa em seu próximo ataque, causando efeitos adicionais.
spells.tooltip: Twisted Fate begins shuffling his deck, allowing him to Recast to lock in one of three cards and enhance his next Attack. The Blue Card deals {{ bluedamage }} magic damage and restores {{ e6 }} Mana . The Red Card deals {{ reddamage }} to nearby enemies and Slows by {{ e2 }}% for 2.5 seconds. The Gold Card deals {{ golddamage }} and Stuns for {{ e3 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Stacked Deck
spells.description: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage. In addition, his Attack Speed is increased.
spells.descriptionPt: A cada 4 ataques, Twisted Fate causa dano adicional. Além disso, sua Velocidade de Ataque aumenta.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Twisted Fate gains {{ attackspeedbonus }}% Attack Speed and every 4th Attack deals an additional {{ bonusdamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Destiny
spells.description: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.
spells.descriptionPt: Twisted Fate prevê o futuro de seus adversários, revelando todos os Campeões inimigos e habilitando o uso de Portal, que o teleporta para qualquer local-alvo em 1,5s.
spells.tooltip: Twisted Fate focuses on his cards, granting True Sight of all enemy champions on the map for {{ e1 }} seconds and allowing him to Recast . Recast : Twisted Fate teleports up to {{ e4 }} units away.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Deadly Venom
passive.description: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit , dealing true damage each second.
passive.descriptionPt: Os ataques básicos de Twitch infectam o alvo %i:OnHit% ao contato , causando Dano Verdadeiro a cada segundo.

spells.name: Ambush
spells.description: Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration. When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.
spells.descriptionPt: Twitch fica Camuflado por um curto período e recebe Velocidade de Movimento. Ao sair da Camuflagem, Twitch recebe Velocidade de Ataque por um curto período. Quando um Campeão inimigo com Veneno Mortal é abatido, o Tempo de Recarga de Emboscada é reiniciado.
spells.tooltip: Twitch Camouflages and gains {{ movespeedmod }}% Move Speed for {{ stealthduration }} seconds. The Move Speed increases to {{ hiddenspeed }}% while near an enemy champion that can't see him. After exiting Camouflage , Twitch gains {{ attackspeedmod*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ attackspeedduration }} seconds. When an enemy champion dies while afflicted with Venom , this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Venom Cask
spells.description: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.
spells.descriptionPt: Twitch joga um tonel de veneno que explode em uma área, causando Lentidão e veneno mortal aos alvos.
spells.tooltip: Twitch hurls a cask that adds a stack of Deadly Venom to all enemies struck and leaves behind a toxic cloud that persists for {{ duration }} seconds. Enemies that remain within the cloud are Slowed by {{ totalslowamount }}% and receive an additional stack of Deadly Venom each second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Contaminate
spells.description: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.
spells.descriptionPt: Twitch causa ainda mais destruição em inimigos envenenados com uma explosão de suas pestes.
spells.tooltip: Deals {{ basedamage }} physical damage to all nearby enemies affected by Deadly Venom , plus an additional {{ physicaldamageperstack }} physical damage and {{ magicdamageperstack }} magical damage per stack of Deadly Venom . Max Damage: {{ maxphysicaldamage }} physical damage and {{ maxmagicdamage }} magical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spray and Pray
spells.description: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.
spells.descriptionPt: Twitch desfere o poder total de sua besta, fazendo disparos de longuíssimo alcance que perfuram todos os inimigos pegos em seu trajeto.
spells.tooltip: Twitch unleashes his crossbow, gaining {{ bonusrange }} Attack Range and {{ bonusad }} Attack Damage , and causing his Attacks to become piercing bolts for {{ duration }} seconds. These bolts hit all enemies they pass through, but deal {{ falloffdamage*100 }}% less damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of {{ minimumfalloffdamage*100 }}% damage. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Bridge Between
passive.description: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances and can Recast an Ability to renew it with Ultimate benefits. Additionally, after using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks gain Attack Speed.
passive.descriptionPt: Udyr tem quatro Habilidades básicas que o fazem alternar entre Posturas e pode Reconjurar uma Habilidade para renová-la com efeitos adicionais na ultimate. Além disso, após usar uma Habilidade, os próximos dois Ataques de Udyr recebem Velocidade de Ataque.

spells.name: Wilding Claw
spells.description: Udyr gains attack speed and his next two attacks deal bonus physical damage. Recast: Gain even more attack speed, and the next two attacks call lightning to strike the target.
spells.descriptionPt: Udyr recebe Velocidade de Ataque, e seus próximos dois Ataques causam Dano Físico adicional. Reconjuração: recebe ainda mais Velocidade de Ataque, e seus próximos dois Ataques conjuram relâmpagos no alvo.
spells.tooltip: Claw Stance: Udyr gains {{ attackspeedbase*100 }}% Attack Speed and his Attacks deal {{ onhitdamage }} physical damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit for {{ attackspeeddurationbase }} seconds. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks in this stance deal a bonus {{ maxhponhit1 }} max Health physical damage and gain {{ attackrange }} range. Awaken: Increase bonus Attack Speed to {{ empoweredtotalas }} and max Health damage to {{ q2totalonhithpdamage }} . Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks call lightning six times, dealing a total of {{ empoweredlightningbonusmax }} max Health magic damage to isolated targets (strikes bounce to other nearby targets when possible). {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Iron Mantle
spells.description: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him. Recast: Gain an even bigger shield and heal based on max health over the next couple seconds.
spells.descriptionPt: Udyr recebe um Escudo e seus próximos dois Ataques o curam. Reconjuração: recebe um Escudo ainda maior e cura com base na Vida máxima pelos próximos segundos.
spells.tooltip: Mantle Stance: Udyr gains {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks gain {{ lifesteal*100 }}% Life Steal and restore {{ lifeonhit }} Health . Awaken: Gain {{ recastshield }} Shield , restore {{ recastheal }} Health over {{ shieldduration }} seconds, and Udyr's next two Attacks instead have {{ lifesteal*200 }}% Life Steal and restore {{ lifeonhitawakened }} Health . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Blazing Stampede
spells.description: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack against each target will Stun them. Recast: Gain even more movement speed and immunity to immobilizing effects for a couple seconds.
spells.descriptionPt: Udyr recebe Velocidade de Movimento e causa Atordoamento em seu primeiro Ataque a cada alvo. Reconjuração: recebe ainda mais Velocidade de Movimento e imunidade a efeitos imobilizadores por alguns segundos.
spells.tooltip: Stampede Stance: Udyr gains {{ movespeed }} Move Speed , decaying over {{ movespeedduration }} seconds. Additionally, Udyr's Attacks dash him to the target and Stun for {{ stunduration }} seconds ({{ icd }} second Cooldown per target). Awaken: Grants immunity to Immobilizing and Disabling effects and an additional {{ movespeedbonus }} Move Speed for {{ unstoppableduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Wingborne Storm
spells.description: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Recast: Empower and unleash the storm, causing it to track enemies and deal additional damage.
spells.descriptionPt: Udyr cerca a si mesmo com uma tempestade glacial, causando dano e Lentidão a inimigos próximos. Reconjuração: fortalece e desencadeia a tempestade, fazendo com que ela siga inimigos e cause dano adicional.
spells.tooltip: Storm Stance: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm for {{ buffduration }} seconds, dealing {{ stormdamage }} magic damage per second to nearby enemies and Slowing them by {{ slowpotency*100 }}%. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks in this stance deal {{ pulsedamage }} magic damage to enemies in the storm. Awaken: Unleash the storm, causing it to follow Udyr's last Attacked enemy, deal an additional {{ percenthpblast }} max Health magic damage over the duration, and Slow by an additional {{ empoweredslow }}.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Echoing Flames
passive.description: Urgot's basic attacks and Purge periodically trigger blasts of flame from his legs, dealing physical damage.
passive.descriptionPt: Os ataques básicos de Urgot e Expurgar disparam periodicamente explosões de chamas de suas pernas, causando Dano Físico.

spells.name: Corrosive Charge
spells.description: Fires an explosive charge at the target location, dealing physical damage and slowing enemies caught in the explosion.
spells.descriptionPt: Detona uma carga explosiva no local-alvo, causando Dano Físico e reduzindo a velocidade dos inimigos atingidos pela explosão.
spells.tooltip: Urgot fires an explosive charge, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Purge
spells.description: Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies. Prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and triggers Echoing Flames.
spells.descriptionPt: Urgot reduz sua velocidade enquanto descarrega sua arma contra inimigos próximos. Prioriza Campeões inimigos que tenha atingido recentemente com outras habilidades e aciona Chamas Ecoantes.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Urgot's other Abilities mark the last champion hit for 5 seconds. Active: Urgot begins firing his chain gun at the closest enemy, prioritizing marked enemies. He Attacks them {{ wattackspersecond }} times a second dealing {{ damagepershot }} physical damage per shot. Urgot can move while firing and has {{ slowresistance }}% Slow resistance, but loses {{ movespeedmod }} Move Speed . At max rank, this Ability lasts indefinitely and can be Toggled on and off.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Disdain
spells.description: Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.
spells.descriptionPt: Urgot avança em uma direção, protegendo-se com um escudo e pisoteando inimigos não Campeões. Se atingir um Campeão inimigo, ele para e o arremessa para fora de seu caminho.
spells.tooltip: Urgot charges forward, gaining {{ etotalshieldhealth }} Shield for {{ eshieldduration }} seconds. The first champion hit is Stunned for {{ stunduration }} seconds and thrown behind Urgot. All enemies Urgot collides with take {{ edamage }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Fear Beyond Death
spells.description: Urgot fires a chem-drill that impales the first enemy champion hit. If that champion falls below a health threshold, Urgot judges them weak and can execute them.
spells.descriptionPt: Urgot dispara uma broca química que perfura o primeiro Campeão inimigo atingido. Se esse Campeão ficar abaixo de um limite mínimo de Vida, Urgot o julgará fraco e o executará.
spells.tooltip: Urgot fires a chem-drill, impaling the first champion hit, dealing {{ rcalculateddamage }} physical damage and Slowing for {{ rslowduration }} seconds by 1% per 1% missing Health, up to {{ rmovespeedmod }}%. If the impaled victim falls below {{ rhealththreshold }}% Health, Urgot can Recast this Ability, Suppressing the victim and dragging them to himself. On reaching Urgot, they are killed and nearby enemies are Feared for {{ rfearduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Living Vengeance
passive.description: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.
passive.descriptionPt: Ao conseguir um abate ou assistência, Varus recebe Dano de Ataque e Poder de Habilidade temporariamente. O efeito é maior se o inimigo for um Campeão.

spells.name: Piercing Arrow
spells.description: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.
spells.descriptionPt: Varus prepara um poderoso disparo, que ganha alcance e dano extra quanto mais demorar para ser lançado.
spells.tooltip: Begin Charging: Varus draws back his next shot, Slowing himself by {{ movespeedmod*-100 }}%. After {{ maxchannelduration }} seconds, if not fired, Varus will cancel the Ability and refund {{ manarefund*100 }}% of its Mana cost. Release: Varus releases the arrow, dealing {{ totaldamagemin }} physical damage , reduced by {{ falloffpercent*100 }}% per enemy hit (minimum {{ mindamagepercent*100 }}%). Damage and Blight detonation effects are increased by up to {{ maxchannelamp*100 }}% based on charge time (up to to {{ totaldamagemax }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Blighted Quiver
spells.description: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.
spells.descriptionPt: Passivo: Os ataques básicos de Varus causam Dano Mágico adicional e aplicam Arruinar. As outras habilidades de Varus detonam os acúmulos de Arruinar, causando Dano Mágico com base na Vida máxima do alvo. Ativo: Varus fortalece sua próxima Flecha Perfurante.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Varus' Attacks deal an additional {{ onhitdamage }} magic damage and apply a Blight stack for {{ debuffduration }} seconds (max {{ maxstacks }} stacks). Varus' other Abilities detonate Blight stacks dealing {{ percenthpperstack }} max Health magic damage per stack (max {{ maxpercenthpperstack }} max Health damage ). Detonating Blight on champions and epic monsters also reduces his basic Abilities' Cooldowns by {{ cdrperblightstack*100 }}% of their Maximum per stack. Active: Varus' next Piercing Arrow deals an additional {{ qempowerpercenthp }} missing Health magic damage , increased up to {{ maxqempowerpercenthp }} missing Health damage based on charge time.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hail of Arrows
spells.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.
spells.descriptionPt: Varus dispara uma chuva de flechas que causa Dano Físico e profana o terreno. Terrenos profanados reduzem a Velocidade de Movimento, autocura e regeneração dos inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deals {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and desecrates the ground for {{ groundduration }} seconds, Slowing enemies by {{ slowpercent*-100 }}% and applying {{ grievousamount*100 }}% Grievous Wounds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Chain of Corruption
spells.description: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.
spells.descriptionPt: Varus lança um tentáculo de corrupção que causa dano e imobiliza o primeiro Campeão inimigo atingido, espalhando-se ainda para os Campeões inimigos próximos que ainda não estiverem infectados, imobilizando-os ao contato.
spells.tooltip: Varus flings out a tendril of corruption, Rooting the first champion hit for {{ rootduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Rooted enemies gain {{ passivestacks }} Blight stacks over the duration. The corruption spreads from its target to uninfected enemy champions. If it reaches them, they take the same damage and Root .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Night Hunter
passive.description: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.
passive.descriptionPt: Vayne caça implacavelmente os malfeitores, ganhando Velocidade de Movimento ao se deslocar em direção a Campeões inimigos próximos.

spells.name: Tumble
spells.description: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.
spells.descriptionPt: Vayne dá uma cambalhota, equilibrando-se para efetuar seu próximo disparo. Seu próximo ataque causará dano adicional.
spells.tooltip: Vayne rolls a short distance, and deals an additional {{ adratiobonus }} physical damage on her next Attack. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Silver Bolts
spells.description: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things. The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.
spells.descriptionPt: Vayne aprimora suas flechas com um metal raro, tóxico a qualquer coisa maligna. A cada terceiro ataque consecutivo ou habilidade contra o mesmo alvo causa um percentual da Vida máxima do alvo como Dano Verdadeiro adicional.
spells.tooltip: Passive : Every third consecutive Attack or Ability against an enemy deals an additional {{ totaldamage }} max Health true damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Condemn
spells.description: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, knocking them back and dealing damage. If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.
spells.descriptionPt: Vayne puxa uma pesada besta de suas costas e dispara um gigantesco projétil em seu alvo, arremessando-o para trás e causando dano. Caso colida com terreno, ele fica empalado, o que lhe causa dano adicional e atordoamento.
spells.tooltip: Vayne fires a bolt that Knocks Back and deals {{ totaldamage }} physical damage . If the target collides with terrain, they take {{ empowereddamagett }} bonus physical damage and become Stunned for {{ stunduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Final Hour
spells.description: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed from Night Hunter
spells.descriptionPt: Preparando-se para um confronto épico, Vayne recebe Dano de Ataque aumentado, invisibilidade durante o Rolamento, Tempo de Recarga do Rolamento reduzido e mais Velocidade de Movimento adicional de Caçadora Noturna
spells.tooltip: Vayne gains {{ bonusattackdamage }} Attack Damage for {{ baseduration }} seconds, extended by {{ durationtoadd }} seconds whenever a champion damaged by Vayne dies within {{ damagedmarkerduration }} seconds. Additionally, during the duration: Night Hunter instead grants {{ movementspeed }} Move Speed . The Cooldown of Tumble is reduced by {{ tumblecdreduction }}%, and grants Invisibility for {{ tumblestealthduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
passive.description: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.
passive.descriptionPt: Veigar é o maior ser maligno a chegar ao coração de Runeterra - e vai ficar cada vez maior! Atingir um Campeão inimigo com uma habilidade ou executar um golpe final concede a Veigar um aumento permanente de Poder de Habilidade.

spells.name: Baleful Strike
spells.description: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.
spells.descriptionPt: Veigar faz um disparo de energia das trevas que causa Dano Mágico aos dois primeiros inimigos atingidos. Unidades abatidas por este disparo concedem a ele um pouco de Poder de Habilidade permanentemente.
spells.tooltip: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first two enemies hit. If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains {{ spell.veigarpassive:dqkillstacks }} stack of Phenomenal Evil . Large minions and large monsters grant {{ spell.veigarpassive:dqkillstackslarge }} stacks instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Dark Matter
spells.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.
spells.descriptionPt: Veigar invoca uma grande massa de Matéria Escura que cai do céu sobre o local-alvo, causando Dano Mágico ao chegar no chão. Os acúmulos de Poder Maligno Fenomenal reduzem o Tempo de Recarga de Matéria Escura.
spells.tooltip: Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Every {{ spell.veigarpassive:pstacksperdarkmattercdr }} stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ spell.veigarpassive:darkmattercdrincrement*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Event Horizon
spells.description: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.
spells.descriptionPt: Veigar distorce os limites do espaço, criando uma prisão que Atordoa os inimigos que a atravessam.
spells.tooltip: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through for {{ stunduration }} seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Primordial Burst
spells.description: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.
spells.descriptionPt: Explode o Campeão-alvo inimigo, causando uma grande quantia de Dano Mágico, que aumenta com base na Vida perdida do alvo.
spells.tooltip: Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between {{ mindamage }} and {{ maxdamage }} magic damage , increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Organic Deconstruction
passive.description: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Organic Deconstruction to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.
passive.descriptionPt: As habilidades de Vel'Koz aplicam Desconstrução Orgânica nos inimigos ao contato. Ao chegar a 3 acúmulos, o inimigo receberá uma rajada de Dano Verdadeiro.

spells.name: Plasma Fission
spells.description: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.
spells.descriptionPt: Vel'Koz dispara um projétil de plasma que se divide em dois ao ser reativado ou ao atingir um inimigo. O projétil causa dano e redução de velocidade a inimigos ao contato.
spells.tooltip: Vel'Koz shoots a plasma bolt that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slows by {{ slowamount*100 }}% decaying over {{ slowduration }} second(s). At the end of its range, on hitting a target, or on Recasting , the bolt splits and fires two new bolts at a 90 degree angle. Killing a unit with this restores {{ tooltipmanarefund }} Mana .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Void Rift
spells.description: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.
spells.descriptionPt: Vel'Koz abre uma fenda ao Vazio que causa uma rajada inicial de dano, explodindo em seguida para causar mais dano após um breve intervalo.
spells.tooltip: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void, dealing {{ initialdamage }} magic damage . The rift then erupts, dealing {{ secondarydamage }} magic damage . This Ability has 2 charges ({{ ammorechargetime }} second refresh).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tectonic Disruption
spells.description: Vel'Koz causes an area to explode, knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away.
spells.descriptionPt: Vel'Koz faz com que uma área exploda, arremessando inimigos ao ar e afastando inimigos próximos.
spells.tooltip: Vel'Koz disrupts a nearby area, causing it to explode, Knocking Up for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Enemies close to Vel'Koz will be Knocked Back instead of Knocked Up .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
spells.namePt: Raio Desintegrador de Formas de Vida
spells.description: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.
spells.descriptionPt: Vel'Koz desfere um raio canalizado que segue o cursor por 2,5s, causando Dano Mágico. Desconstrução Orgânica pesquisa Campeões inimigos, fazendo com que recebam Dano Verdadeiro em vez de Dano Mágico.
spells.tooltip: Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that follows the cursor, dealing a total of {{ totaldamage }} magic damage over 2.5 seconds and Slowing by {{ e3 }}%. Deals true damage instead to enemies recently damaged by Organic Deconstruction . Enemies gain stacks of Deconstruction periodically while in the beam.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Doom 'n Gloom
passive.description: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.
passive.descriptionPt: Periodicamente, Vex é fortalecida, fazendo com que a próxima Habilidade básica dela cause Temor aos inimigos e interrompa avanços. Sempre que um inimigo próximo avança, Vex aplica uma marca que é consumida para causar dano adicional, além de reduzir o Tempo de Recarga do estado fortalecido.

spells.name: Mistral Bolt
spells.description: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight.
spells.descriptionPt: Lança um projétil que causa dano e acelera no meio do trajeto.
spells.tooltip: Vex launches a wave of mist that deals {{ qdamagecalc }} magic damage . After a delay, the wave becomes smaller and faster. Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Personal Space
spells.description: Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Recebe um Escudo e causa dano a inimigos próximos.
spells.tooltip: Vex gains {{ shieldcalc }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds and emits a shockwave that deals {{ wdamagecalc }} magic damage . Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Looming Darkness
spells.description: Summon a damaging and slowing zone that applies Gloom to enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Invoca uma área que causa dano e Lentidão aos inimigos, além de aplicar Escuridão.
spells.tooltip: Vex commands Shadow to fly to a location, increasing in size as it travels. Upon arriving, it deals {{ edamagecalc }} magic damage and Slows by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Killing an enemy with this ability reduces Doom'n Gloom's Cooldown by {{ gloomcdnonchamptooltip*100 }}%. Applies Gloom to enemies hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Shadow Surge
spells.description: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion. Recast to dash to them and deal damage.
spells.descriptionPt: Dispara um projétil que marca um Campeão inimigo. Reconjure para avançar até o alvo e causar dano.
spells.tooltip: Shadow excitedly surges forward, dealing {{ spell.vexr:rdamagecalc }} magic damage and marking the first enemy champion hit for 4 seconds. Recast : Dash to the marked champion, dealing {{ spell.vexr:recastdamagecalc }} magic damage on arrival. If the marked champion dies within {{ spell.vexr:takedownwindow }} seconds of taking damage from this Ability, its Cooldown is temporarily reset.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Blast Shield
passive.description: Vi charges a shield over time. The shield can be activated by hitting an enemy with an ability.
passive.descriptionPt: Vi carrega um escudo ao longo do tempo que pode ser ativado ao atingir um inimigo com uma habilidade.

spells.name: Vault Breaker
spells.description: Vi charges her gauntlets and unleashes a vault shattering punch, carrying her forward. Enemies she hits are knocked back and receive a stack of Denting Blows.
spells.descriptionPt: Vi carrega suas manoplas e desfere um soco capaz de quebrar cofres, empurrando-a para frente. Os inimigos que ela atingir são empurrados para trás e recebem um acúmulo de Pancada Certeira.
spells.tooltip: Begin Charging: Vi begins charging a powerful punch, Slowing herself by {{ selfslow }}%. Release: Vi dashes forward dealing between {{ totaldamage }} and {{ maxdamagetooltip }} physical damage based on charge time and applying Denting Blows to all enemies hit. Vi stops upon colliding with an enemy champion, and Knocks them Back .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Denting Blows
spells.description: Vi's punches break her opponent's Armor, dealing bonus damage and granting her Attack Speed.
spells.descriptionPt: Os socos de Vi quebram a Armadura de seu oponente, causando dano adicional e concedendo a ela Velocidade de Ataque.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Every 3rd Attack on the same target deals an additional {{ totaldamagetooltip }} max Health physical damage , removes {{ shredamount }}% Armor and grants Vi {{ attackspeed }}% Attack Speed for {{ sharedbuffsduration }} seconds. It also reduces the remaining Cooldown of Blast Shield by {{ spell.vipassive:cdreductionon3hit }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Relentless Force
spells.description: Vi's next attack blasts through her target, dealing damage to enemies behind it.
spells.descriptionPt: O próximo ataque de Vi atravessará seu alvo, causando dano aos inimigos atrás dele.
spells.tooltip: Vi's next Attack deals {{ totaldamagetooltip }} physical damage to the target and enemies behind them. This Ability has 2 charges ({{ ammorechargetime }} second refresh).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Cease and Desist
spells.description: Vi runs down an enemy, knocking aside anyone in the way. When she reaches her target she knocks it into the air, jumps after it, and slams it back into the ground.
spells.descriptionPt: Vi persegue um inimigo em alta velocidade, empurrando para longe qualquer um em seu trajeto. Ao alcançar o alvo, ela o arremessa ao ar, salta atrás dele e o golpeia de volta ao chão.
spells.tooltip: Vi singles out an enemy champion, revealing them and dashing unstoppably towards them. Upon reaching them, Vi Knocks them Up for {{ rstunduration }} seconds and deals {{ damage }} physical damage . Any other enemies Vi collides with are dealt damage, knocked aside, and Stunned for {{ secondarytargetstunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Sovereign's Domination
passive.description: Enemies who fall before Viego become wraiths. By attacking a wraith, Viego temporarily seizes control of the dead enemy's body, healing for a percentage of his target's max health and gaining access to their basic abilities and items. He replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own.
passive.descriptionPt: Inimigos derrotados por Viego se tornam Espectros. Ao atacá-los, Viego toma controle do corpo do inimigo morto temporariamente, curando-se em um percentual da Vida máxima do alvo e ganhando acesso a seus itens e habilidades básicas. Ele substitui a ultimate da vítima por uma conjuração gratuita de sua própria ultimate.

spells.name: Blade of the Ruined King
spells.description: Viego's spectral blade passively deals bonus percent current Health damage On-Hit and strikes twice vs. enemies he recently hit with an Ability, stealing Health. Viego can activate this Ability to thrust his zweihander forward, impaling enemies in front of him.
spells.descriptionPt: A lâmina espectral de Viego causa uma porcentagem da Vida atual do alvo como dano adicional ao contato de forma passiva e atinge duas vezes os inimigos recentemente afetados por uma Habilidade, roubando Vida. Viego pode ativar essa Habilidade para golpear, perfurando inimigos à frente.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Viego's Attacks deal an additional {{ totalpercenthealthonhit }} current Health physical damage . His first Attack against an enemy he has recently damaged with an Ability hits a second time, dealing {{ secondattackdamage }} physical damage and restoring {{ healmodvschamps*100 }}% of damage dealt as Health . These bonuses are kept during Possession . Active: Viego stabs forward, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spectral Maw
spells.description: Viego charges up before dashing forward, releasing a ball of concentrated Black Mist that stuns the first enemy hit.
spells.descriptionPt: Viego carrega antes de avançar, lançando uma esfera de Névoa Negra concentrada que atordoa o primeiro inimigo atingido.
spells.tooltip: Begin Charging: Viego begins gathering Mist, Slowing himself by {{ selfslowpercent*100 }}%. Release: Viego dashes forward and hurls the gathered Mist. Deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Stuns the first enemy hit for {{ stunduration }} to {{ maxstuntt }} seconds based on charge time. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Harrowed Path
spells.description: Viego commands the Black Mist to haunt and surround a piece of terrain. Viego can hide in the Mist as a wraith, gaining camouflage, Move Speed, and Attack Speed.
spells.descriptionPt: Viego ordena que a Névoa Negra assombre e cerque uma porção de terreno. Ele pode se esconder na Névoa como um Espectro, recebendo Camuflagem, Velocidade de Movimento e Velocidade de Ataque.
spells.tooltip: Viego sends forth a spectre to haunt the first terrain hit, surrounding it with Mist for {{ mistduration }} seconds. Viego gains Camouflage , {{ totalmovespeed }} Move Speed , and {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed while inside the Mist.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Heartbreaker
spells.description: Viego teleports to a nearby location and executes an enemy champion on arrival, piercing their heart and causing a destructive shockwave around them that knocks away their allies.
spells.descriptionPt: Viego teleporta-se para um local próximo e executa um Campeão inimigo ao chegar, atravessando seu coração e liberando uma onda de choque destrutiva que empurra os inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Viego discards any souls he is currently Possessing and teleports. On arrival he Attacks the champion with the lowest percent Health, briefly Slowing them by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% and dealing {{ totaldamage }} + {{ totalpercenthealth }}% missing Health physical damage . Other nearby enemies are Knocked Back and take {{ totaldamage }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Glorious Evolution
passive.description: Viktor gains Hex Fragments whenever he kills an enemy. With every 100 Hex Fragments he obtains, Viktor permanently augments an active ability. After upgrading all of his basic abilities, he can gather 100 Hex Fragments to augment his ultimate ability.
passive.descriptionPt: Viktor receberá Fragmentos Hex sempre que abater um inimigo. Com 100 Fragmentos Hex obtidos, ele receberá permanentemente o Aprimoramento de uma habilidade ativa. Depois de aprimorar todas as habilidades básicas, ele pode obter 100 Fragmentos Hex para aprimorar a ultimate.

spells.name: Siphon Power
spells.description: Viktor blasts an enemy unit with magic damage, which grants him a shield and empowers his next basic attack. Augment: Siphon Power's shield is increased by 60% and Viktor gains bonus move speed after casting the Ability.
spells.descriptionPt: Viktor explode uma unidade inimiga com Dano Mágico, recebendo um Escudo e fortalecendo seu próximo ataque básico. Aprimoramento: o Escudo de Poder do Sifão aumenta em 60% e Viktor recebe Velocidade de Movimento adicional depois de conjurar a habilidade.
spells.tooltip: Viktor blasts an enemy, dealing {{ totalmissiledamage }} magic damage and granting Viktor {{ shieldlevelscaling }} Shield for {{ buffduration }} seconds. Viktor's next Attack within 4 seconds deals {{ attacktotaldmg }} magic damage . Upgraded: Grants {{ totalaugmentedshieldvalue }} Shield and Viktor additionally gains {{ augmentmovespeedbonus }}% Move Speed for {{ buffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Gravity Field
spells.description: Viktor conjures a heavy gravitational field that slows enemies caught within its radius. Enemies who stay in the field for too long become stunned. Augment: Viktor's spells apply a slow to enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Viktor conjura um campo gravitacional pesado que causa Lentidão a inimigos atingidos pelo seu raio de ação. Inimigos que permanecem tempo demais no campo são atordoados. Aprimoramento: as habilidades de Viktor causam Lentidão a inimigos atingidos.
spells.tooltip: Viktor deploys a gravitational imprisonment device for {{ fieldduration }} seconds, Slowing enemies inside it by {{ slowpotency*-1 }}%. Enemies who remain within its radius for 1.25 seconds are Stunned for {{ stunduration }} seconds. Upgraded Passive: Viktor's Abilities Slow by {{ augmentslow }}% for 1 second. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hextech Ray
spells.description: Viktor uses his biomechanical arm to fire a Hextech Ray that cuts across the field in a line, dealing damage to all enemies in its path. Augment: An explosion follows in the Hextech Ray's wake, dealing magic damage.
spells.descriptionPt: Viktor usa seu braço biomecânico para disparar um Raio Hextec que corta o campo em linha reta, causando dano a todos os inimigos no trajeto. Aprimoramento: uma explosão segue o rastro do Raio Hextec, causando Dano Mágico.
spells.tooltip: Viktor fires a hextech ray in a chosen direction, dealing {{ laserdamage }} magic damage to any enemies it hits. Upgraded: An aftershock follows Hextech Ray, dealing {{ aftershockdamage }} magic damage . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Arcane Storm
spells.description: Viktor conjures an Arcane Storm on the field, dealing magic damage and interrupting enemy channels. The storm periodically does magic damage to all nearby enemies and can be redirected by Viktor. Augment: The Arcane Storm moves 25% faster, and whenever champions die after taking damage from it, the storm grows and increases in its duration.
spells.descriptionPt: Viktor conjura uma Tempestade Arcana no campo, causando Dano Mágico e interrompendo canalizações inimigas. A Tempestade causa Dano Mágico periodicamente a todos os inimigos próximos e pode ser redirecionada por Viktor. Aprimoramento: A Tempestade Arcana se move 25% mais rapidamente e, sempre que Campeões morrem após sofrer dano dela, aumenta de tamanho e duração.
spells.tooltip: Viktor conjures an Arcane Storm in an area for {{ stormduration }} seconds, which instantly deals {{ initialburstdamage }} magic damage followed by {{ subsequentburstdamage }} magic damage per second to surrounding enemies. The storm automatically follows champions it has recently damaged. Recast: Viktor can manually move the storm. Upgraded: The storm moves {{ augmentboost*100 }}% faster. If a champion that the storm has damaged dies, the storm increases its size and its duration by {{ tooltip_durationextension }} seconds (up to {{ maxgrowths }} times). {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Crimson Pact
passive.description: Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power and every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health (does not stack with itself).
passive.descriptionPt: Cada 30 pontos de Vida adicional concedem 1 de Poder de Habilidade a Vladimir, e cada 1 ponto de Poder de Habilidade concede a ele 1,6 de Vida adicional (não cumulativos entre si).

spells.name: Transfusion
spells.description: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time.
spells.descriptionPt: Vladimir rouba vida do inimigo-alvo. Quando sua reserva estiver cheia, Transfusão terá os benefícios de dano e cura drasticamente aumentados por um breve período.
spells.tooltip: Vladimir drains his target's lifeforce, dealing {{ basedamagetooltip }} magic damage and restoring {{ basehealtooltip }} Health . After using this Ability twice, Vladimir gains {{ movementspeedonq2 }}% Move Speed for 0.5 seconds and empowers the next use of this Ability for {{ frenzyduration }} seconds. The empowered version of this Ability deals {{ empowereddamagetooltip }} magic damage instead and restores an additional {{ empoweredhealtooltip }} plus {{ empoweredhealpercenttooltip }} missing Health .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Sanguine Pool
spells.description: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.
spells.descriptionPt: Vladimir mergulha numa poça de sangue, tornando-se inalvejável por 2s. Além disso, inimigos na poça sofrem redução de Velocidade de Movimento e Vladimir drena Vida deles.
spells.tooltip: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood for 2 seconds, gaining {{ hasteboost*100 }}% decaying Move Speed for {{ hasteduration }} second and becoming Untargetable and Ghosted while Slowing enemies in the pool by {{ movespeedmod*-100 }}%. Vladimir deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and restores {{ totalheal }} Health per enemy over the duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tides of Blood
spells.description: Vladimir pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood which, when released, deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.
spells.descriptionPt: Vladimir paga com a própria Vida para carregar uma reserva de sangue que, quando desferida, causa dano em área ao seu redor, mas pode ser bloqueada por unidades inimigas.
spells.tooltip: Begin Charging: Vladimir charges up a reservoir of blood, spending up to {{ chargehealthtooltip }} Health . While at full charge, Vladimir is Slowed by 20%. Release: Vladimir unleashes a torrent of blood missiles at surrounding enemies, dealing between {{ mindamagetooltip }} and {{ maxdamagetooltip }} magic damage based on charge time. If this Ability was charged for at least 1 second, it also Slows targets by {{ slowpercent }}% for 0.5 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hemoplague
spells.description: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.
spells.descriptionPt: Vladimir infecta uma área com uma praga virulenta. Inimigos afetados recebem dano crescente enquanto durar o efeito. Depois de alguns segundos, Hemopraga causa Dano Mágico aos inimigos infectados e cura Vladimir a cada Campeão inimigo atingido.
spells.tooltip: Vladimir creates a virulent plague, causing its victims to take {{ damageamp }}% increased damage from all sources for {{ duration }} seconds. After it expires, Vladimir deals {{ damage }} magic damage to all infected targets. Vladimir restores {{ damage }} Health if he hits a champion, and restores an additional {{ secondaryhealingtooltip }} Health for each champion beyond the first.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: The Relentless Storm
passive.description: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.
passive.descriptionPt: Os Ataques e habilidades de Volibear concedem Velocidade de Ataque e, às vezes, fazem com que seus Ataques causem Dano Mágico adicional a inimigos próximos.

spells.name: Thundering Smash
spells.description: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks.
spells.descriptionPt: Volibear ganha velocidade ao correr na direção dos inimigos, Atordoando e causando dano ao primeiro que Atacar.
spells.tooltip: Volibear gains {{ minspeedcalc }} Move Speed , doubled to {{ maxspeedcalc }} towards enemy champions for the next {{ duration }} seconds. While active, Volibear's next Attack deals {{ calculateddamage }} physical damage and Stuns the target for {{ stunduration }} second. Volibear becomes enraged if an enemy Immobilizes him before he Stuns a target, ending the Ability early but refreshing its Cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Frenzied Maul
spells.description: Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and marking them. Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear.
spells.descriptionPt: Volibear causa dano a um inimigo, marcando-o e aplicando efeitos ao contato. Conjurar a habilidade novamente no mesmo alvo causa dano adicional e cura Volibear.
spells.tooltip: Volibear mauls an enemy, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and marking them for {{ markduration }} seconds. If this Ability is used on a marked target, its damage is increased to {{ empowereddamage }} and Volibear restores {{ baseheal }} plus {{ percentmissinghealthhealingratio }} missing Health .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Sky Splitter
spells.description: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.
spells.descriptionPt: Volibear invoca um relâmpago em um local, causando dano e Lentidão aos inimigos. Ele também ganhará um Escudo se estiver no raio da explosão.
spells.tooltip: Volibear summons a thundercloud that fires a lightning bolt, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} plus {{ percentdamage*100 }}% max Health magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. If Volibear is inside the blast zone, he gains a {{ shieldapratiotooltip }} plus {{ shieldamount*100 }}% max Health Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Stormbringer
spells.description: Volibear leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health. Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.
spells.descriptionPt: Volibear salta até um local-alvo, causando dano e Lentidão aos inimigos sob ele, além de receber Vida adicional. Torres inimigas próximas ao local de pouso são temporariamente Desabilitadas.
spells.tooltip: Volibear transforms and leaps, gaining {{ healthamount }} Health and {{ bonusattackrange }} Attack Range for the next {{ transformduration }} seconds. Upon landing, Volibear cracks the earth, Disabling nearby towers for {{ towerdisableduration }} seconds and dealing {{ towerdamagetooltip }} physical damage to them . Nearby enemies are Slowed by {{ slowamount*100 }}%, decaying over 1 second. Enemies directly underneath Volibear suffer {{ sweetspotdamagetooltip }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Eternal Hunger
passive.description: Warwick's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples.
passive.descriptionPt: Os ataques básicos de Warwick causam Dano Mágico adicional. Se ele estiver com menos de 50% de Vida, cura a si mesmo com a mesma quantia. Se ele estiver com menos de 25% de Vida, a cura é triplicada.

spells.name: Jaws of the Beast
spells.description: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.
spells.descriptionPt: Warwick lança-se à frente e morde seu alvo, causando dano com base em sua Vida máxima e curando a si mesmo com o dano causado.
spells.tooltip: Tap: Warwick lunges forward and bites, dealing {{ basebitedamage }} plus {{ targetpercenthpdamage }}% max Health magic damage and healing for {{ lifestealpercent }}% of the damage dealt . Hold: Warwick lunges and clamps his jaws on the target, leaping behind them. While clamped, Warwick follows all movement of the target. After releasing his hold, he does the same damage and healing.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Blood Hunt
spells.description: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health, gaining Move Speed toward and attack speed against them. When they fall below 25% health, he frenzies and these bonuses triple.
spells.descriptionPt: Warwick detecta inimigos com menos de 50% de Vida, recebendo Velocidade de Movimento ao deslocar-se na direção deles e Velocidade de Ataque ao atacá-los. Quando eles ficarem com menos de 25% de Vida, Warwick entrará em frenesi e esses efeitos triplicarão.
spells.tooltip: Passive: Warwick can sense champions below 50% Health, gaining {{ passivemsbonus }}% Move Speed towards them. Spells and attacks against enemies below 50% Health grant {{ passiveasbonus }}% Attack Speed . These effects are increased by 200% against enemies below 25% Health. Active: Warwick can briefly sense all enemies, and gains this Ability's passive effect against the closest champion for 8 seconds, regardless of Health. If no champions are found, this Ability's cooldown is reduced by 30%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Primal Howl
spells.description: Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.
spells.descriptionPt: Warwick recebe redução de dano por 2,5 segundos. Ao fim do efeito, ou caso seja reativado, ele uiva, fazendo com que inimigos próximos fujam por 1 segundo.
spells.tooltip: Warwick gains {{ dramount }}% damage reduction for {{ drduration }} seconds. After it ends, Warwick howls, Fearing nearby enemies for {{ fearduration }} second. Warwick can Recast to end the Ability early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Infinite Duress
spells.description: Warwick leaps in a direction (scaling with his bonus Move Speed), suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds.
spells.descriptionPt: Warwick salta em uma direção (escalando com a Velocidade de Movimento adicional dele), suprimindo o primeiro Campeão atingido por 1,5s.
spells.tooltip: Warwick leaps a huge distance that scales with his Move Speed , Suppressing the first champion he collides with while he channels for {{ rduration }} seconds. He attacks that champion 3 times over the duration, dealing {{ damagecumulative }} magic damage . Warwick heals for 100% of all damage dealt during the channel.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Clean Cuts
passive.description: After using an ability, Xayah's next basic attacks will hit all targets along their path and leave a Feather .
passive.descriptionPt: Depois de usar uma habilidade, os próximos ataques básicos de Xayah acertam todos os alvos pelo caminho e deixam uma Pluma .

spells.name: Double Daggers
spells.description: Xayah throws two damaging daggers that also drop Feathers she can recall.
spells.descriptionPt: Xayah arremessa dois punhais que causam dano e deixam cair Plumas que podem retornar para ela.
spells.tooltip: Xayah throws two daggers, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage each and leaving two Feathers . Targets hit after the first take {{ multihitdamage }} damage from each dagger.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Deadly Plumage
spells.description: Xayah creates a storm of blades that increase her Attack Speed and damage while also granting her Move Speed if she attacks a champion.
spells.descriptionPt: Xayah cria uma tempestade de lâminas que aumenta seu dano e sua Velocidade de Ataque, além de conceder Velocidade de Movimento ao atacar um Campeão.
spells.tooltip: Xayah creates a storm of blades for {{ wattackspeedduration }} seconds that grants her {{ wattackspeedamount }}% Attack Speed and cause her Attacks to fire a secondary blade that deals {{ bonusdamagepercent }}% damage. When the secondary blade hits a champion, she grants herself {{ wmovespeedamount }}% Move Speed for {{ wmovespeedduration }} seconds. If Rakan is nearby he will also gain the effects of this Ability, except he gains Move Speed when Xayah strikes a target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Bladecaller
spells.description: Xayah calls back all her dropped Feathers dealing damage and rooting enemies.
spells.descriptionPt: Xayah recolhe todas as Plumas que caíram, causando dano e enraizando os inimigos.
spells.tooltip: Xayah calls all Feathers back to her, dealing {{ featherdamage }} physical damage each. If {{ featherthreshold }} or more Feathers hit an enemy, they are Rooted for {{ rootduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Featherstorm
spells.description: Xayah leaps into the air becoming untargetable and throwing out a fan of daggers, dropping Feathers she can recall.
spells.descriptionPt: Xayah salta pelo ar, ficando inalvejável e arremessando um leque de punhais, além de deixar cair Plumas que podem voltar para ela.
spells.tooltip: Xayah leaps into the air becoming Untargetable and Ghosted for 1.5 seconds before raining down daggers that deal {{ damage }} physical damage and leave behind a line of Feathers .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Mana Surge
passive.description: Xerath's basic attacks periodically restore Mana. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced.
passive.descriptionPt: Os ataques básicos de Xerath restauram Mana periodicamente. Sempre que Xerath abate uma unidade, esse Tempo de Recarga é reduzido.

spells.name: Arcanopulse
spells.description: Fires a long-range beam of energy, dealing magic damage to all targets hit.
spells.descriptionPt: Dispara um raio de energia de longo alcance, causando Dano Mágico a todos os alvos atingidos.
spells.tooltip: Begin Charging: Xerath begins charging an arcane beam, Slowing himself gradually up to 50%. Release: Xerath fires the beam, dealing {{ tooltiptotaldamage }} magic damage . The range increases with time charged.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Eye of Destruction
spells.description: Calls down a barrage of arcane energy, slowing and dealing magic damage to all enemies in an area. Targets in the middle receive additional damage and a stronger slow.
spells.descriptionPt: Invoca uma barragem de energia arcana, causando Dano Mágico e redução de Velocidade de Movimento a todos os inimigos em uma área. Alvos no centro recebem dano adicional e uma redução de velocidade mais forte.
spells.tooltip: Xerath calls down a blast of arcane energy, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing them by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Enemies in the center take {{ sweetspottotaldamage }} magic damage instead and are Slowed by {{ sweetspotslowamount*100 }}%, decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Shocking Orb
spells.description: Deals magic damage to an enemy and stuns them.
spells.descriptionPt: Causa Dano Mágico a um inimigo e o atordoa.
spells.tooltip: Xerath fires an orb of raw magic, Stunning the first enemy hit for up to {{ maxstunduration }} seconds based on distance travelled, and dealing {{ tooltiptotaldamage }} magic damage . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Rite of the Arcane
spells.description: Xerath immobilizes himself and gains numerous long-range barrages.
spells.descriptionPt: Xerath imobiliza a si mesmo e dispara diversas barragens de longa distância.
spells.tooltip: Xerath ascends to his true form and channels for {{ duration }} seconds. During this time he may Recast up to {{ numberofshots }} times. Recast: Xerath launches a magical artillery, dealing {{ tooltiptotaldamage }} magic damage . For each champion hit, the artillery deals an additional {{ rampdamagecalc }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Determination
passive.description: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.
passive.descriptionPt: Cada terceiro ataque básico causa dano adicional e cura Xin Zhao.

spells.name: Three Talon Strike
spells.description: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.
spells.descriptionPt: O próximos 3 ataques normais de Xin Zhao causam mais dano. O último arremessa o oponente ao ar.
spells.tooltip: Xin Zhao's next 3 Attacks deal an additional {{ bonusdamage }} physical damage and reduces his other Ability's Cooldowns by 1 second. The third Attack also Knocks Up for {{ knockupduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Wind Becomes Lightning
spells.description: Xin Zhao slashes in front of himself with his spear, then thrusts it forward, slowing affected enemies and marking them as Challenged.
spells.descriptionPt: Xin Zhao golpeia à frente com a lança, causando Lentidão e marcando os inimigos atingidos como Desafiados.
spells.tooltip: Xin Zhao slashes, dealing {{ slashdamage }} physical damage , then thrusts, dealing {{ thrustdamage }} . Enemies hit by the thrust are Slowed by {{ e6 }}% for {{ totalslowduration }} seconds. Champions and Large Monsters hit by the thrust are marked as Challenged for {{ markduration }} seconds and revealed unless Stealthed .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Audacious Charge
spells.description: Xin Zhao charges to an enemy, gaining increased Attack Speed and dealing damage to all enemies in the area, slowing them briefly. This Ability gains increased range against Challenged targets.
spells.descriptionPt: Xin Zhao avança na direção de um inimigo, ganhando Velocidade de Ataque e causando dano e Lentidão a todos os inimigos na área temporariamente. Esta Habilidade recebe alcance aumentado contra alvos Desafiados.
spells.tooltip: Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing {{ chargedamage }} magic damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by {{ slowamount }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Xin Zhao grants himself {{ f1 }}% (%i:scaleAS%%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed for {{ asduration }} seconds. This Ability's range is increased on enemies that are Challenged . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Crescent Guard
